jobs.title: It`s time to build!
jobs.description:
Join us in developing the zero-emission energy solutions of the future!

 

We firmly believe that nuclear power will be a major part of the solution for future zero-emission maritime propulsion systems. The team realizing this ambition is being created now. Do you want to be a part of it ?

Senior Mechanical Engineer

About the position:

 

We are looking for you to be part of a growing team of motivated colleagues to develop, test and build our maritime Gen IV nuclear power systems to power future ships. You will contribute to build the first prototype of a complete marine nuclear power system based on our gas-cooled reactor technology. A significant part of the work is preparing, producing, testing and improving the different components in the system, while at the same time building the complete power system test rig and demonstrating this in a moving environment. We are looking for a strong personal interest in the topic and a drive to create safe and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Testing – Norway.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Creating, testing and improving reactor system parts and solutions
  • Design and build test environments for different parts.
  • Take part in building the complete nuclear power system with test facilities, and perform the testing required.

  • Collaborate closely with the nuclear engineers in Emerald Nuclear Inc., as well as our partners and suppliers.

     

Qualifications:

 

  • Strong interest in working with complex thermal energy systems and engineering challenges.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within the topic of mechanical engineering, systems engineering, thermodynamics, and/or material engineering.
  • Master-level education within Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or similar topics. Bachelor level candidates may also apply combined with relevant work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical work experience within materials or mechanical production.
  • Experience with building and handling digital control systems or sensor networks is an advantage.
  • Previous experience with nuclear technology is not required. Necessary training in nuclear applications will be provided.

 

Personal qualities:

 

  • Strong interest in nuclear energy, mechanical engineering, maritime technology and similar topics.
  • Works independently, but comfortable with teamwork.
  • Interested in working with and solving challenges.
  • Structured and methodical.
  • Proactive and positive attitude.

 

Why Emerald Nuclear ?

This is your opportunity to participate in the beginning of a groundbreaking new industry development. With us you are not just working with a new type of technology. You will be part of the development of a completely new energy platform for maritime applications, with the potensial to combine zero-emission technololgy, unprecedented energy density and high reliability.

 

We can offer:

 

  • The opportunity to work with innovative and ground-breaking new technology
  • Be a part of creating completely new prototypes
  • Work in the apex between nuclear technology, mechanics and thermal systems.
  • Competitive salary, pension scheme and insurance package
  • Flexible work hours.
  • Personal development.
  • Free parking.

  • Work location at our engineering and test hub at Stette near the town of Ålesund.

     

We are building the team now:

 

Emerald Nuclear Norway shall lead market development, engineering, testing and the construction of maritime nuclear power systems. We have a very strong ambition to launch a demonstrator in 2031. And we need competent people on this journey. Are you ready to go?

 

Additional positions soon to be announced soon:

 

  • Senior Mechanic
  • Thermal systems engineer
  • Control systems engineer

 

It`s time to build!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Its time to build! Emerald Nuclear Norway AS is a wholly owned subsidiary of Emerald Nuclear Inc., a maritime nuclear energy company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Located in Ålesund, Norway, the company aims to lead market development, engineering, testing, and commerzialisation of maritime nuclear energy systems. Lately there has been a fundamental shift in attitudes toward nuclear energy and its role in the decarbonization of the maritime industry. Nuclear energy has the potential to provide a commercially viable zero-emission alternative to fossil fuels, while delivering the energy efficiency, endurance, and operational reliability required by the maritime market. We place the highest focus on the safety, security and safeguards in order to protect people, ships, communities, and the environment throughout the entire lifecycle of the ship and its nuclear energy system. Our objective is clear: to enable the deployment of the first commercial nuclear-powered offshore demonstration vessel on the Norwegian Continental Shelf by 2031.

jobs.title: vi söker kontaktperson åt en 15 årig tjej

1 plats(er).

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som kontaktperson till en av våra kunder. Kunden, en 15 årig tjej som bor en bit utanför Knivsta. Hennes intressen är: spela tv spel, spela spel online, gå på bio, rita, bowla och gå ut och fika.

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för att göra något för andra människor. Du utgår från den enskildas behov och intressen och anpassar dig efter situationer. Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-09-01  , upphör: 2027-06-30  .

Knivsta kommun vill ta tillvara de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.

We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.

This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.


What You'll Do

Lead the transformation

  • Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.

  • Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.

  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

Proven B2B sales and business-development experience.

Demonstrated experience in negotiating and successfully closing commercial deals.

Relevant sales experience in scaffolding, construction equipment, industrial products, building materials, equipment rental or another comparable B2B sector.

Ability to independently develop new customer relationships and manage the complete sales process.

Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

Experience using leading CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive or comparable systems.

Professional-level Finnish and English communication skills.

Ability and willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

A proactive, target-oriented and highly independent approach to work.

German or French is particularly valued. Other relevant European language skills are also considered an advantage.

Considered an advantage

Hos os er sygeplejersken en aktiv del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at den bedste sygepleje opstår, når faglighed og nærvær går hånd i hånd. Derfor skal du have lyst til både at varetage sygeplejefaglige opgaver og tage del i den daglige pleje.

jobs.title: Development Engineer- Heat Pump & Refigeration Systems
jobs.description:
Location: Kronoberg, on-site

Start: ASAP

Term: 12 months, with the possibility of extension

Assignment type: Consulting/ freelance assignment



We are looking for a Test & Development Engineer for a product development team in Kronoberg, working with energy-efficient technology based on refrigeration and heat pump principles. The team is currently developing the next generation of energy-efficient product, where heat pump technology is used to recover and reuse heat within the system rather than continuously heating incoming air. The technology has strong similarities to systems used in refrigeration, heat pumps, air conditioning and dehumidification.



You will join a small and experienced development team and work hands-on with products that are currently in the development and verification phase. The main focus will be on testing, analysis and understanding product behavior, rather than designing completely new systems.



The role

This is not a traditional test role where you simply execute predefined test cases and report the results. We are looking for someone with the technical understanding to recognize when a system is behaving unexpectedly, investigate why and communicate the findings to the development team.

You will work close to the physical product in a laboratory and development environment, collecting and analyzing data and evaluating how the system behaves under different conditions.



Your responsibilities may include:

    Planning and performing tests on products and heat pump/refrigeration systems
    Collecting, analyzing and interpreting measurement data
    Identifying unexpected behavior, deviations and potential technical issues
    Understanding how changes in the system affect overall product performance
    Supporting troubleshooting and root cause analysis
    Performing software updates and verifying system behavior

jobs.title: Mine Geologist for Kiruna Underground Mine
jobs.description:
Are you interested in developing the ore model accuracy in a world-class underground iron ore mine?

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

Our Kiruna Mine Geology department is looking for a Mine Geologist focused on 3D modelling, block modelling, and cross-departmental collaborations. In this role, you will work closely with our mine planning, rock engineering, and survey crews, as well as production operations, external drilling contractors and commercial laboratories. This is an environment where collaboration, reliability, and automated innovations are highly valued.

Responsibilities include providing updated production block models, as well as 3D geological models, based on face mappings, core logging, and assay data to ensure high-confidence ore body alignment with stope designs and mining plans. You will deliver accurate grade control data to mine planners and engineers for blasting and dilution management. Additionally, you will handle and validate large datasets, support ore tracking and grade control processes, perform reconciliation analyses between geological models and mining outcomes, and collaborate closely with mine planners, engineers and production teams to continuously improve model accuracy and data quality.

What you bring

If you have an analytical mindset, work well both independently and collaboratively, and like handling and interacting with large datasets, you will likely thrive in this role in a supportive team environment. You are communicative, proactive, and enjoy collaborating across functions to improve workflows and achieve shared goals. A responsible, flexible, and solution-oriented approach will be important in your daily work.

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    Preferably M.Sc. and minimum B.Sc. in Geology, Geological Engineering, Earth Sciences, or equivalent
    Proficiency in 3D modelling softwares (like Leapfrog Geo & Edge or Datamine)
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driver’s license (equivalent to Swedish B driver's license for manual transmission vehicles)

It is advantageous if you have:

    Proficiency in the Deswik software
    Experience of resource estimation
    Previous experience of geological mapping, core logging, and/or managing assay QA/QC databases
    Previous experience from underground mining operations
    Experience from leadership roles, such as in exploration/infill drilling programs

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to submit your application.

Start: According to agreement

Location: Kiruna

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time, daytime

Contact: For more information about the position, please contact the hiring manager Viola Friberg (viola.friberg@lkab.com +46703249337).

Union representatives Kiruna/ Svappavaara:

    Sakari Alanko, Unionen, 0980-725 08
    Ledarna Norra, ledarna.norra@lkab.com
    Peter Johansson, Akademikerföreningen, 0980-718 79

LKAB är en internationell gruv- och mineralkoncern med norra Sverige som bas och hela världen som arbetsplats. Vileder vägen mot koldioxidfri produktion och vi gör det tillsammans – i en öppen, varm och säker arbetsmiljö medteknologi och utveckling i fokus. Vi välkomnar utmaningar, innovativa idéer och initiativförmåga, alltid medjämställdhet och mångfald i fokus.

Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Stigby på Visingsö har plats för 35 ungdomar och tar emot icke skolpliktiga pojkar med psykosocial problematik, kriminalitet och missbruk. Vi är uppdelad på en MBB-avdelning (mottagning- och behovsbedömning), fyra behandlingsavdelningar och en utskrivningsförberedande avdelning i Jönköping.

Arbetsbeskrivning

SiS ungdomshem Stigbys skolverksamhet erbjuder undervisning för 35 ungdomar. Eleverna studerar inom introduktionsprogrammet. De erbjuds grundskoleämnen, olika gymnasieämnen samt yrkesinriktad praktisk utbildning med inslag från arbetslivet i form av APL. Det finns fyra yrkesprogram: industri, bygg, fordon och transport samt restaurang- och livsmedelsprogrammet. Därtill har vi en fotbollsinriktning vilket innebär ett nära samarbete med öns fotbollsklubb då fotboll är ett viktigt inslag i både skola och behandlingsverksamhet. Undervisningen sker i små grupper. Skolverksamheten är en mycket viktig framgångsfaktor inom institutionsvården och den största skyddsfaktorn för våra ungdomar.

Ditt uppdrag innebär att undervisa inom fordon och transport. För att lyckas med ditt läraruppdrag krävs det att du kan bygga relationer med dina elever - det är utgångspunkten i vårt arbete som leder till att eleverna utvecklar sitt lärande och sina förmågor. Din personliga lämplighet är nyckeln till livsviktig förändring. Därför behöver du vara en empatisk person som drivs av en stark inre glöd och vilja att skapa resultat utöver det vanliga. Att du är en kollega som delar kunskap och bidrar till vi-känslan på SiS är andra egenskaper som gör dig intressant. Lika viktigt är det att du har en grundmurad positiv människosyn och en förmåga att hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Vi arbetar i arbetslag och där vi förväntar oss att du bidrar med dina kunskaper, lärdomar och där kollegialt lärande är en naturlig del i ditt läraruppdrag. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar tillsammans för en positiv arbetsmiljö och där allas idéer respekteras och välkomnas.

Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig i första hand som är yrkeslärare och har behörighet att undervisa inom fordon och transport, alternativt har minst fem års erfarenhet från branschen och en stark drivkraft att undervisa och handleda elever.

Följande krav ser vi att du uppfyller:

    Gedigen erfarenhet inom branschen
    God människosyn- där alla människors lika värde är en självklarhet och att du har en interkulturell medvetenhet
    Pedagogisk insikt- där du är flexibel i ditt tänk, kreativ och arbetar gärna tematisk och ämnesövergripande
    Empatisk förmåga och är relationsskapande då du inser att relation är grunden till elevens lärande och utveckling
    Samarbetsförmåga samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och ta egna initiativ
    Personlig mognad, är stabil, har integritet och är tydlig
    Uthållighet - du ger inte upp i första taget utan tror på eleven och dess förmågor att lyckas i sitt lärande
    B-körkort

Meriterande:

    Tidigare erfarenhet av undervisning för vår målgrupp

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Tillträde: 2026-12-01 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Fackliga representanter:

Abdoulaye Soukouna, OFR, 010-453 39 00, Abdoulaye.Soukouna@stat-inst.se

Rodrigue Kakunze, SEKO, 010-453 39 00, Rodrigue.Kakunze@stat-inst.se

Klara Goh, SACO-S, 010-453 39 00, Klara.Goh@stat-inst.se

Ansökan:

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast 2026-10-04.

SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.

För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Barnvakt Nanny Torslanda 1-2 gng/v
jobs.description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!

Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj med två barn vid åldrarna 6 och 9 år. De önskar hjälp 1-2 gånger per vecka ca kl. 15:00-19:00. Även hjälp sporadiskt på helger. Är meritkrav med körkort för uppgifterna.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

    Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
    Kurs i barn-HLR
    Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
    Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
    Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
    Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
    Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen

Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

jobs.title: FiberTekniker – Vi lærer dig op!
jobs.description:
Er du ufaglært håndværker og nysgerrig på fiber?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger dig med gå på mod og hvor hænderne er skruet rigtig på til fibersplidsning hos Hr. og Fru Danmark.

Erfaring med fibersplidsning er ikke nødvendig – vi lærer dig op. Det vigtigste er, at du har gåpåmod og kan sætte flueben ved følgende:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Bor max 30 min kørsel fra Rødding

  • Har kørekort – du får nemlig firmabil

  • Taler og forstår dansk på højt niveau

  • Har rolige hænder og godt syn (du skal arbejde med meget tynde fiber)

  • Er tryg med en boremaskine og har hænderne skruet rigtigt på

  • Er tryg ved at bruge computer, iPad eller lignende til dokumentation

  • Er kundeminded og god til at snakke med folk (også dem, der har mange spørgsmål)

  • Er struktureret og systematisk (du elsker tjeklister!)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Mødestabil

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring – der vil være sidemandsoplæring 1-2 uger

  • Firmabil, arbejdstøj, værktøj, telefon og iPad

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så vent ikke med at søge.

Er du interesseret i at høre mere?
Kontakt Line Mai Hyttelkjær på tlf. 69663647 eller mail: LMA@viktech.dk

jobs.title: Resurspedagog till Nacka Musikklasser, Nacka kommun
jobs.description:
Är du en trygg och engagerad person som vill bidra till att nästa generations sångare och musiker får utvecklas i en inspirerande miljö? Hos Nacka Musikklasser får du kombinera elevnära arbete med en unik musik- och konsertverksamhet där musik, lärande och gemenskap går hand i hand. Nu söker vi en resurspedagog som vill göra skillnad för våra elever varje dag. Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Ditt uppdrag

Som resurspedagog på Nacka Musikklasser arbetar du nära elever i årskurs 4–6 för att skapa trygghet, studiero och goda förutsättningar för lärande och utveckling. Din huvudsakliga placering är på Järla skola, men du stöttar vid behov elever och verksamhet inom hela Nacka Musikklasser, från årskurs 4 till 9. Du ger stöd till elever både enskilt och i grupp under skoldagen, både i undervisningen, på raster och i sociala sammanhang. I uppdraget ingår även att vara medföljande vuxen vid skolutflykter, repetitionsdagar, konserter och andra aktiviteter som är en naturlig del av verksamheten. Du följer regelbundet med elever till bland annat Berwaldhallen, kyrkor och andra konsertarenor och bidrar till att aktiviteterna genomförs på ett tryggt och välorganiserat sätt. Du tillhör arbetslaget för årskurs 4–6 och samarbetar med lärare, mentorer och biträdande rektor för att skapa en sammanhållen, trygg och utvecklande skoldag för våra elever.

I tjänsten ingår också administrativa och samordnande uppgifter kopplade till skolans konsertverksamhet. Det kan exempelvis handla om att ta fram klasslistor, skriva ut material, sammanställa konsertprogram och stötta i planering och koordinering inför konserter och arrangemang.

Arbetstiden är huvudsakligen dagtid, men kvälls- och helgarbete förekommer i samband med konserter och andra arrangemang. Sådana aktiviteter planeras med god framförhållning.

Din erfarenhet

För denna tjänst krävs att du har:

    utbildning inom barn- och ungdomsområdet, pedagogik eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
    erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och ungdomar
    erfarenhet av att samordna aktiviteter, arrangemang eller liknande verksamhet
    erfarenhet av att stödja elever både enskilt och i grupp
    intresse för musik
    god digital kompetens
    god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du även har:

    erfarenhet av administrativa arbetsuppgifter
    erfarenhet av att arbeta inom skolverksamhet
    erfarenhet av att arbeta med elever inom grundskolan, gärna i årskurs 4-9
    erfarenhet av körsång eller annan musikalisk verksamhet.

Är det här du?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med barn och unga och som vill bidra till en trygg, inkluderande och utvecklande skolmiljö. Du är en trygg vuxen med förmåga att skapa struktur, tydlighet och goda relationer med elever. Du samarbetar väl med lärare, skolledning och kollegor och bidrar aktivt till att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för elevernas lärande och utveckling. Du arbetar noggrant och strukturerat, har god planeringsförmåga och kan hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt. Du kommunicerar tydligt, bemöter andra professionellt och skapar förtroende i dina relationer. Eftersom verksamheten omfattar utflykter, repetitioner, konserter och andra aktiviteter behöver du vara flexibel och lösningsorienterad. Du anpassar dig till förändrade förutsättningar, behåller lugnet i nya situationer och bidrar till att aktiviteter genomförs på ett tryggt och välorganiserat sätt. Du har även ett intresse för musik och trivs i en verksamhet där musik, konserter och körsång är en naturlig del av elevernas vardag.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi erbjuder dig

Nacka Musikklasser bedriver sin undervisning på Järla skola (åk 4–6) och Eklidens skola (åk 7–9). Från höstterminen 2026 har Nacka Musikklasser blivit en egen skolenhet inom Järlahöjdens rektorsområde. Verksamheten har funnits sedan 1984 och kännetecknas av hög kvalitet, starka resultat och ett stort engagemang för elevernas utveckling, både kunskapsmässigt och musikaliskt. För oss är det viktigt att våra elever känner lust och glädje inför musik och musicerande. Genom undervisning och konserter på hög konstnärlig nivå vill vi bidra till elevernas personliga, sociala och musikaliska utveckling samt lägga grunden för en livslång relation till musik. Läs mer om oss här.

Hos oss blir du en del av en verksamhet med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor som stöttar varandra och arbetar tillsammans för elevernas bästa. Du erbjuds ett varierat arbete där ingen dag är den andra lik, med möjlighet att kombinera elevnära arbete med en unika musik- och konsertverksamhet. Tjänsten som resurspedagog är en ny roll hos oss, vilket ger dig goda möjligheter att påverka rollen och utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten.

Som anställd i Nacka kommun har du tillgång till flera förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag på 3 000 kr per år, tillgång till gym, möjlighet att köpa SL-kort via nettolöneavdrag, förmånscykel samt stöd från kommunens olika interna stödfunktion.

Intresserad?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev och bedömer enbart din ansökan utifrån ditt CV och dina svar på ett antal frågor som du får besvara i samband med ansökan. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 23 september 2026!

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering.

Bakgrundskontroll kan komma att tillämpas.

Besök gärna Nackas kommunala skolor och förskolors karriärsida här

Nacka är en av Sveriges mest attraktiva och välrenommerade kommuner. Med fokus på mål, resultat, hållbart medarbetarengagemang och ständig utveckling strävar Nacka efter att bli bäst på att vara kommun. Nacka kommun är arbetsgivaren för dig som med stor frihet förnyar och gör skillnad.

jobs.title: Hallintosihteeri
jobs.description:
**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä


**Arvostamme:**

- Kykyä kannatella samanaikaisesti useita lankoja

- Sujuvia tiimi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Positiivista otetta ja kehittämishalua


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Toimitusjohtaja Teemu Vanharanta, teemu.vanharanta@panchovilla.fi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen **rekry@panchovilla.fi** viimeistään **9.9.2026**. Toimi kuitenkin nopeasti, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajan puitteissa ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.title: R&D Mechanical Engineer  HVDC Windings
jobs.description:
For our HVDC Transformers research and development team we are looking for a R&D mechanical engineer in the field of Transformer Winding/Active part technology. You will lead activities to improve transformer winding/active part performance, design and manufacturing methods while challenging legacy routines and developing better suited concepts for the future. The role will cooperate closely with experts in different transformer technology fields as well as with transformer design and manufacturing specialists globally. You will build and maintain a network with the HVDC Transformer factories globally, collecting the inputs and supporting implementation of new development.  

Working in R&D will give you the possibility to use your creativity to solve a wide spectrum of challenges. You will have exciting and varied work in front of you where you will get a broad network internally and externally. Work with both the local factory and the global organization within Transformers and have career development opportunities as a Specialist or as a Project Manager.

Your responsibilities

    Creating conceptual designs of Transformer windings to meet specified requirements (functional, technical, quality, etc).
    Ability to create detailed design and 3D modeling as well as running mechanical verifications using simulation tools.
    Running Design for Excellence practices (DFA, DFM, FMEA, etc.).
    Preparing reports and related documents in accordance with internal and external requirements.
    Technical standards: Ensure that winding-related processes and calculation methods are state of the art. Work with programmers to implement and test new methods in the design software.
    Technical support: Support the design, manufacturing, quality and supply chain organizations with technical expertise to ensure that technical requirements are fulfilled.
    Technical leadership and knowledge sharing: Coach and provide support and technical advice to colleagues on winding-related topics. Maintain a network of engineering professionals to share best practices across different disciplines and the HVDC Transformer factories.

Your background

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

Som institusjonskokk med fagansvar vil du bidra til at våre beboere får næringsrike, trygge og smakfulle måltider hver dag. Du vil få mulighet til å påvirke menyutvikling, rutiner og fagutvikling i et kjøkken som er en viktig del av omsorgen vi gir.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fagansvar for institusjonskjøkkenet
  • Planlegging og produksjon av varme og kalde måltider
  • Tilrettelegging av spesialkost og ernæringstiltak
  • Oppfølging og videreutvikling av IK-mat og HACCP-rutiner
  • Menyplanlegging
  • Fokus på bærekraft og reduksjon av matsvinn
  • Varebestilling og lagerstyring
  • Veiledning og faglig støtte til kollegaer
  • Samarbeid med ledelse, pleiepersonell og øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø og god service overfor beboere og pårørende
Vi søker deg som
  • Har fagbrev som institusjonskokk, ernæringskokk eller kokk
  • Har interesse for ernæring og mat til eldre
  • Har kunnskap om spesialkost, allergener og trygg mathåndtering
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for kvalitetsarbeid og fagutvikling
  • Er strukturert og selvstendig
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

Det er en fordel dersom du har erfaring fra institusjonskjøkken eller storkjøkken.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. Vi ser etter en person som:

  • Er opptatt av kvalitet og detaljer
  • Er positiv og løsningsorientert
  • Er fleksibel og utviklingsorientert
  • Har stolthet i faget sitt
  • Ser betydningen av gode måltider for helse, trivsel og livskvalitet
Vi tilbyr
  • Fast 100 % stilling
  • En sentral fagrolle med påvirkningsmuligheter
  • Variert og meningsfylt arbeidshverdag
  • Mulighet til å utvikle kjøkken- og ernæringstilbudet ved Myreheimen
  • Dyktige kolleger og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariff og kvalifikasjoner
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Mulighet for videreutvikling av kjøkkentjenestene i Øksnes, der du vil ha store påvirkningsmulihgeter og medbestemmelse.
Velkommen til Myreheimen

Hos oss blir du en viktig del av hverdagen til mennesker som setter stor pris på gode måltider. Vi ønsker å skape måltidsopplevelser som gir både næring, trivsel og glede.
Vi håper du vil være med på laget.

Øksnes for flere. Øksnes for deg? Som ansatt i Øksnes Kommune vil du ha 400 kollegaer i ulike etater og tjenester. Det finnes mange spennende jobbmuligheter hos Øksnes Kommune! Vi oppfordrer alle til å søke jobb hos oss uavhengig av alder, kjønn, etnisitet og funksjonsevne. Her kan du utvikle deg og ha stor innflytelse på hvordan organisasjonen drives. Vi stiller med faglig og personlig utvikling, et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode lønn- og pensjonsvillkår. Nysgjerrig på Øksnes Kommune som arbeidsplass? Ring en Øksnesværing og slå av en uformell prat. jobs.description:
Bemanningssenteret treng fleire tilsette til vårt Ressursteam og har ledig 100% fast stilling. Som medarbeidar i Ressursteamet vil du dekke viktige arbeidsområde i driftsavdelingane på sjukehuset.

Medarbeidarar som blir tilsett får opplæring i arbeid ved Hospitaldrift Reinhald, café, Matforsyning og Vaskeri. Dei som blir tilsett vil få god opplæring og skal jobbe innan alle desse fagområda, ut frå dei behova som blir meldt til Bemanningssenteret. Dette er ein stilling med mykje variasjon i arbeidet og kor ein får god innsikt i drifta i sjukehuset.

På oppdrag frå Hospitaldrift planlegg Bemanningssenteret kor vikarane til ei kvar tid skal arbeide. Medarbeidarane har fast turnus med arbeidstid 07.00-15.00, og pt arbeid kvar 4. helg.

Vikarane våre er viktige arbeidstakarar i Hospitaldrift og vi søker deg som sett store krav til deg sjølv når det gjeld kvalitet i arbeidet. Stor variasjon i arbeidet og fleire arbeidsstader krev svært gode norskkunnskapar og gode kommunikasjonsevner. Arbeidet kan vere fysisk krevande og krev god helse. Det er ein fordel med erfaring frå fleire av fagområda i Hospitaldrift.

Personlege eigenskapar
  • Sjølvstendig og fleksibel

  • Punktleg og nøyaktig
  • Serviceinnstilt
  • Helse til fysisk krevande arbeid
  • Bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Technical Sales & Business Development Manager - Paper & Board
jobs.description:
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?



About the job

In this exiting role as Business Development Manager Paper & Board, you will lead the technical and commercial advancement of Nouryon’s Paper, Board and tissue business in Europe. With ownership of key CMC applications, you will drive innovation, strengthen customer partnerships, and help position Nouryon as the preferred solutions provider in tissue and barrier coatings.



In your future role as Business Development Manager, you will

    Conduct technical audits and diagnostics at Nordic key accounts and selected distributors to identify opportunities for CMC, surfactants and chelates (with focus on wet end tissue and barrier coating).
    Work closely and support the Account Manager to develop and manage a strategic key account plan implementing innovation and enabling multi‑level engagement, thereby strengthening customer proximity and long‑term partnership.
    Maintain regular technical and innovation touchpoints with key account R&D and distributor technical teams to align on project pipeline and application roadmaps.
    Provide second line technical support and training for the EMEA distribution network, including joint customer visits and troubleshooting of complex cases.
    Manage sales related KPIs for assigned accounts (volume, margin, price development, project pipeline value, hit rate) and report progress versus targets.



You will work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and R&D to drive customer projects, technical development, and business growth. Externally, you will build strong relationships with paper mills, industrial customers, distributors, and customer R&D and application teams, acting as a trusted technical advisor and partner.

This role requires travel approximately 40-50% of the time, primarily across Europe. Occasional travel to the Middle East and North Africa, including Egypt, may also be required to support customer engagement, technical projects, and business development activities.



We believe you bring

    Great experience within the paper and board process industries, ideally in technical and application, process, or customer-facing role.
    Proven experience in technical sales, or technical service, with direct customer interaction.
    Hands-on experience with tissue, board, specialty paper, barrier coatings, or related applications.
    Experience planning and executing laboratory and mill trials and translating technical outcomes into commercial value.
    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related technical field.



We believe you are...



To be successful in this position you combine strong technical expertise with commercial acumen and can turn technical insight into customer value. You thrive in an independent role with a high degree of ownership, while also collaborating effectively across functions, teams, and countries. Structured and proactive in your approach, you value knowledge sharing, transparency, and strong teamwork to drive results.



We offer you

At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. Our collective agreement is with IKEM. Plus, we offer unilateral perks, such as bonus, reduced hours, health care allowance, lunch allowance, and more.



Have we got your interest?

This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process.

We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff.



We look forward to receiving your application!



About Nouryon

Explore careers and life at Nouryon  

If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.

Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.



Contact

For additional information about the vacancy please contact hiring manager Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA at nicolo.marelli@nouryon.com

If you have any questions about the recruitment process or your application or need assistance, please contact: Recruiting.SE@Nouryon.com

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö - Arsenaali Oy
jobs.description:
[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/51a48aea-9cb3-42cf-8080-ca1ef36998cf/original.jpeg]


ASIAKKUUSPÄÄLLIKKÖ – HALUATKO TEHDÄ TULOSTA JA NÄHDÄ SEN MYÖS PALKASSASI?

Sytytkö tavoitteista, kaupoista ja onnistumisista? Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun ympärillä tapahtuu paljon ja tilanteet vaativat nopeita päätöksiä?

Arsenaalissa pääset vauhdikkaaseen kaupalliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, asiakkuudet ja ihmiset. Tässä työssä et jää odottamaan, että puhelin soi. Tartut itse mahdollisuuksiin, kontaktoit asiakkaita ja pidät huolen siitä, että oikeat työntekijät ja oikeat työtehtävät kohtaavat mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.

Arsenaali on luotettava, vakavarainen ja moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työllistämme päivittäin 250–300 rakennus-, kuljetus- ja ravintola-alan ammattilaista Uudenmaan alueella. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 10,9 miljoonaa euroa.

Nyt etsimme joukkoomme tavoitteellista ja energistä asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta – ja menestyä yhdessä muun joukkueen kanssa.


TÄSSÄ TYÖSSÄ TEKEMISELLÄSI ON SUORA VAIKUTUS TULOKSEEN

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat omista asiakkuuksistasi ja niiden kehittämisestä. Samalla pidät silmät auki uusille kaupallisille mahdollisuuksille.

Yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistäsi on huolehtia henkilöstöpoolimme mahdollisimman korkeasta käyttöasteesta. Kun työntekijän toimeksianto päättyy, tavoitteena on löytää hänelle nopeasti seuraava työ. Kun asiakkaalle syntyy äkillinen tarve, meidän tehtävämme on ratkaista se.

Työpäivääsi kuuluu:

* aktiivinen myynti nykyisille ja uusille asiakkaille

* uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaaminen

* omien asiakkuuksien kehittäminen

* vapautuvien työntekijöiden aktiivinen tarjoaminen asiakkaille

* uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi yhdessä rekrytointitiimimme kanssa

* työntekijöiden työvuoroihin ja toimeksiantoihin liittyvien asioiden hoitaminen

* nopeasti muuttuvien tilanteiden ratkaiseminen.

Työssä tulee vastaan päiviä, jolloin monta asiaa tapahtuu yhtä aikaa. Asiakkaan tarve muuttuu, työntekijä vapautuu ennakoitua aikaisemmin tai sovittu henkilö ei pääsekään töihin. Silloin etsimme ihmistä, joka ei jää ihmettelemään ongelmaa vaan miettii: miten tämä ratkaistaan?


TUNNISTATKO ITSESI?

Emme etsi ensisijaisesti tietyn toimialan osaajaa tai tietyn tutkinnon suorittanutta. Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeanlaista draivia.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

* haluat voittaa ja saavuttaa tavoitteesi

* saat energiaa kaupoista ja onnistumisista

* raha ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaasi motivoivat sinua

* tartut puhelimeen mieluummin kuin jäät odottamaan

* pystyt tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti myös paineen alla

* osaat hahmottaa, missä on hyvä kauppa ja mihin ei kannata käyttää aikaansa

* olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka, vaikka ympärillä olisi kiire

* uskallat olla jämäkkä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa

* epäonnistuminen tai muuttunut tilanne ei pysäytä sinua – siirryt nopeasti seuraavaan ratkaisuun

* olet energinen, ahkera ja nautit korkeasta tekemisen temposta.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta. Kiinnostava taustasi voi löytyä yhtä hyvin esimerkiksi myynnistä, logistiikasta, kuljetusalalta, resursoinnista tai muusta nopeatempoisesta liiketoiminnasta.

Toivomme kuitenkin, että olet jo päässyt näyttämään kaupallista osaamistasi ja tiedät, mitä tavoitteellinen työskentely käytännössä tarkoittaa.

Emme etsi kaikkien miellyttäjää. Etsimme hyvää tyyppiä, joka tulee toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa, mutta uskaltaa myös tehdä päätöksiä, pitää sovituista asioista kiinni ja viedä tilanteet loppuun.


MITÄ SAAT MEILTÄ?

Kun odotamme sinulta paljon, haluamme myös palkita onnistumisesta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* 2 500–4 000 euron suoritusperusteinen pohjapalkka plus bonus kuukaudessa – onnistuminen näkyy omassa palkassasi

* mahdollisuuden työsuhdeautoon

* vahvan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen mentoroinnin

* kokeneen rekrytointitiimin tuen

* osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

* miellyttävät toimitilat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella

* säännöllisen työajan arkisin klo 8–16 toimipaikassamme Helsingissä

jobs.title: Central quality vie f/h (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Nacelles conçoit, intègre et assure le support et le service après-vente des nacelles d'avions. La société est un leader mondial sur le marché des avions commerciaux de plus de 100 places, des avions d'affaires et des avions régionaux. A la pointe de la technologie, Safran Nacelles propose des nacelles toujours plus intégrées au moteur, aérodynamiques, légères avec des traitements acoustiques avancés afin de contribuer à la réduction des émissions de CO2 et sonores des aéronefs.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSafran Nacelles is looking for a VIE Digital Quality & Audit Improvement Engineer to join its Quality team in Burnley, UK.



As part of the Quality organisation, you will contribute to the development and deployment of a new digital internal auditing tool, supporting Safran Nacelles' ambition to transform and digitalise its audit practices.



This assignment will provide the opportunity to work at the intersection of Quality, digitalisation and continuous improvement, while collaborating with different teams across the organisation.



Your missions :



Working closely with the Quality team and relevant stakeholders, you will contribute to the following activities:



Support the development of a new digital internal auditing tool for Safran Nacelles, contributing to the transition towards a more digital and efficient approach to internal audits.

Contribute to the deployment of the digital auditing tool, including supporting users during implementation, preparing training materials and contributing to training sessions.

Support the definition and development of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) associated with the auditing tool, helping to monitor its adoption, performance and effectiveness.

Develop and support the implementation of processes and templates to facilitate the consolidation and analysis of audit results.

Contribute to trend analysis of audit results and associated action plans, helping the Quality team identify recurring issues, improvement opportunities and areas requiring attention.

Support the monitoring of action plans resulting from audits and contribute to the follow-up of improvement actions with the relevant stakeholders.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to the internal audit process and contribute to sharing lessons learned and best practices.

Work collaboratively with Quality, Operations, Engineering and other stakeholders to support the successful deployment and continuous improvement of the digital audit approach.
