jobs.title: Bartender
jobs.description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

jobs.title: Senior Innovation Consultant - EU Projects
jobs.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.

Notre activitéRejoignez un groupe de plus de 100 000 collaborateurs au cœur du développement de nos territoires et résolument tourné vers l'international ! En intégrant BPCE, vous intégrez une entreprise engagée au service du développement et de la coordination de toutes les enseignes du Groupe BPCE (Banque Populaire, Caisse d'Epargne, Crédit Coopératif, Casden, Natixis, Oney, Banque Palatine) afin de porter les ambitions du projet stratégique « Vision 2030 ». BPCE a créé le pôle Digital & Payments en 2021 pour réunir l'ensemble des métiers du digital avec l'ensemble des métiers des paiements du groupe. BPCE Digital & Payments aujourd'hui rassemble les services de paiement et du financement du commerce, le digital, l'IA et la data, l'open banking et l'innovation. Grâce aux 3200 collaborateurs travaillant au sein de marques renommées telles que Oney, BPCE Payment Services, Payplug et Xpollens, le pôle exerce une influence significative sur le marché français et européen. Il permet au groupe et à ses réseaux bancaires de s'appuyer sur des services de banque en ligne et des services de paiement aux meilleurs standards du marché. Pour plus d'informations n'hésitez pas à parcourir notre site : https://www.digital-payments.groupebpce.com/ Vos missions au sein de l'équipeLa direction Innovation & Open Banking du groupe BPCE a pour principales missions de piloter une veille marketing stratégique, d'impulser des transformations business en rupture et de gérer les relations avec les écosystèmes de partenaires innovants.

Les établissements du groupe BPCE sont soumis comme tous les teneurs de comptes aux exigences imposées par la Directive sur les Services de Paiement (DSP2) notamment en matière d'Open Banking. Ils mettent déjà à disposition des tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPPs) des interfaces API afin de fournir les services de paiement régulés : (1) d'Information sur les Comptes (AISP), d'Initiation de Paiement (PISP) et de Disponibilité des fonds (CBPII).

Depuis plusieurs années on constate une forte augmentation de l'usage de ce solutions Open Banking par les TPPs et les clients finaux qui se traduit également par une augmentation des sollicitations des tiers régulés (assistance, demandes, incidents, etc.).

A l'avenir, les exigences DSP2 sont amenées à se renforcer avec la publication à venir de la Réglementation sur les Services de Paiement (RSP) et au-delà du volet réglementaire le groupe BPCE s'est inscrit dans une démarche Open Finance business.
Compte tenu de ces enjeux réglementaires, business et de satisfaction client, le groupe BPCE fait évoluer son « dispositif Open » et souhaite renforcer la gestion de la relation entre les établissements du groupe et les TPPs ainsi que les activités transverses de coordination et de reportings.

Au sein de l'équipe « Innovation Produit et Ecosystèmes », le/la responsable de la Cellule « Open Banking » est le garant de la relation entre BPCE et les partenaires qui se connectent aux données et services du groupe BPCE aussi bien dans le cadre réglementaire (Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2), Règlement sur les services de paiement - RSP), que dans le cadre de relations d'affaires. Dans ce cadre, les principales missions du responsable de la Cellule Open Banking seront de :

- Piloter la relation avec nos partenaires tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPP) dans le cadre de la Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2)
- Coordonner les actions de support en lien avec les directions informatiques et digitales du groupe
- Coordonner l'instruction des incidents et demandes spécifiques et critiques
- Réaliser le reporting interne sur l'activité Open Banking
- Participer à l'évolution des dispositifs pour garantir une qualité de service au standard d marché
- Participer à la coordination des projets d'évolution sur le périmètre Open Banking
- Gérer les évolutions du portail API STORE du groupe BPCE transverse aux différentes lignes métiers du groupe et à destination des partenaires ;
- Participer aux activités de veille et d'écoute des besoins du marché en matière de finance embarquée
- Participer aux activités commerciales relatives aux produits API BusinessVos atouts pour réussirCompétences attendues :

- Connaissance des réglementations sur les services bancaires et les services de paiement notamment sur l'Open Banking (Règlement IP, DSP2, RSP, etc.)

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

#LI-DNP

Relationships & Presence

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 4-5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

jobs.description:
Participe à notre journée exceptionnelle de recrutement pour rejoindre notre Sales Graduate Program chez Alan !

Tu es diplômé(e) d'un Master avec maximum 2 ans d'expérience et tu souhaites débuter ta carrière dans la vente ? Le jeudi 8 Octobre 2026, Alan t’invite à une journée de recrutement exclusive dans nos bureaux parisiens.

Nous ouvrons seulement 24 places pour participer à cette journée, avec l’opportunité unique de décrocher ton CDI au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program. Saisis ta chance de lancer ta carrière en tant que Business Development Representative (BDR) dès Janvier 2027 (ou selon tes disponibilités), d’acquérir des bases solides en vente, et de tracer ta voie vers des rôles Sales seniors chez Alan en 18 à 24 mois !

Pourquoi participer ?

  • Vis une expérience unique & décroche ta place dans notre Sales Graduate Program : un véritable tremplin pour propulser ta carrière dans la vente.

  • Plonge dans l’univers d’Alan : découvre notre vision et notre ambition au contact direct de nos Alaners.

  • Bénéficie d’un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l’issue de la journée.

  • Plonge au cœur du métier de BDR chez Alan : découvre concrètement ce rôle à travers des mises en situation et des échanges privilégiés avec l’équipe.

Le processus de recrutement :

  • 📅 Date de l’événement : Jeudi 8 Octobre 2026

  • 📍 Lieu : Siège d’Alan : 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris

  • ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 1 Octobre 2026

  • 📈 Les étapes :

    • Nous étudions toutes les candidatures reçues pour sélectionner les meilleurs profils.

    • Si ton profil est retenu, nous t’appellerons pour t’annoncer la nouvelle et échanger brièvement sur tes motivations.

    • Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser chez toi : des questions de motivation et un pitch vidéo à enregistrer.

    • Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à rejoindre notre journée exclusive au siège d’Alan, avec au programme une étude de cas et des entretiens.

    • À l’issue de cette journée, nous donnons notre réponse en 48h, et les profils sélectionnés rejoindront l’aventure Alan au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program à partir de Janvier 2027 !

⭐️ Tout savoir sur notre Sales Graduate Program

Le principe ? Sur une période de 18 à 24 mois, nous t’offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein du rôle de Business Development Representative (BDR) en acquérant progressivement des compétences plus avancées dans la vente.

  • Phase 1 : Apprends les bases du métier de BDR : prospection, compréhension du marché, création d’opportunités, échanges avec des décideurs.

  • Phase 2 : Développe ton leadership : en tant que BDR, prends des responsabilités transverses telles que le recrutement, le coaching des nouveaux, l’animation de formations et la gestion de projets.

  • Phase 3 : Spécialise-toi : concentre-toi soit sur la prospection des grands comptes (plus complexes et stratégiques), soit sur les PME, en menant des rendez-vous de découverte et des démonstrations produit.

Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales.

Envie d’en savoir plus sur le Sales Graduate Program ?

👉 Découvre les coulisses de la première promotion ici

👉 Découvre l'équipe en vidéo ici

👉 Découvre comment on a conçu le programme ici

👉 Lis le témoignage inspirant de Diane sur pourquoi la prospection est un art stratégique

👉 Explore notre approche unique de la vente

💥 Es-tu notre candidat idéal ?

Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles plus que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment.

Tu seras un bon fit pour rejoindre l'équipe Sales d'Alan si :

  • Tu détiens un Master d'une école de commerce, avec jusqu'à deux ans d'expérience professionnelle ;

  • Tu montres un intérêt fort pour la vente, et détiens idéalement une première expérience dans ce domaine

  • Tu es enthousiaste, animé(e) par notre mission, et désireux(se) de partager notre ambition ;

  • Tu es team player, organisé(e), et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément ;

  • Tu es désireux(se) d'apprendre et de grandir dans de nouveaux rôles ;

  • Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris ou Bordeaux

Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre Business Development Representative - Graduate Program ?

Pour cette opportunité, nous visons à recruter dans la fourchette de niveau A2-B0.

🐼 Qui sommes-nous ?

La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous.

Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux.

Nous construisons un partenaire santé intégré qui unit harmonieusement assurance et prestations de soins intelligentes en un seul système.

En connectant tous les aspects du soin - privé, public et direct consommateur - nous créons une expérience santé centrée sur nos membres. Grâce à un engagement profond, nous donnons à chacun les moyens de surmonter les obstacles de santé du quotidien et de vivre plus sainement.

🚀 Comment on s'y prend ?

Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons un ensemble de valeurs culturelles qui guident notre approche du travail :

La mission est notre priorité — Nous pensons à long terme et sommes des optimistes méthodiques qui prenons des risques, recherchant avant tout la réussite de notre mission.

Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats.

Transparence radicale — Toutes les informations sont accessibles et consignées par écrit, afin que chacun puisse prendre les meilleures décisions de manière asynchrone.

En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel.

🙌 Avantages & Bénéfices

Chez Alan, nous croyons qu'être en bonne santé est un besoin fondamental, et cela commence avec nos employés. C'est pourquoi les Alaners bénéficient d'un environnement stimulant et d'avantages garantissant qu'ils sont heureux, efficaces et ne passent que du temps de qualité avec leurs collègues.

Par conséquent, nous offrons :

  • Récompenses équitables. Des packages d'equity généreux complètent ton salaire de base.

  • Bureau flexible. Espace de bureau incroyable dans notre HQ à Paris ou hub de co-working sponsorisé à Bordeaux.

  • Tous les outils dont tu as besoin. Équipement haut de gamme : Macbook Pro, clavier, support laptop, écran, et casque anti-bruit.

  • Politique de vacances flexible et horaires de travail flexibles. Organise ton temps comme tu le souhaites.

  • Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement).

  • Transport. Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays.

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver

  • Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

  • Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

  • Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

  • Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

  • Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering.

  • Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities.

  • Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency.

  • Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing.

  • Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including:

    • Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization.

    • Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates).

jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. jobs.title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. 


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. UiB therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and age.

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at all times.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds, or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favourable consideration. We ensure that at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups is invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity. For further information about the recruitment process, click here.


Life as a PhD candidate at UiB

Marion Claireaux tells about life and work as a PhD candidate at UiB.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrtp6VxMeJ4&index=2&list=PLf8ZIYfAO0qjhROTj6SthDbSScg0lSO6G

jobs.title: Cleaning Supervisor
jobs.description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Department of AI
jobs.description:

Role? Experienced Data Scientist joining our Department of AI to develop, experiment with, and build machine learning and AI systems that provide new user experiences and business model innovation, in collaboration with our vertical teams.

Company? Vend, parent company of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA, Bilbasen, as well as other top brands, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

    You are experienced in Data Science & Machine Learning: You have strong fundamental knowledge of machine learning algorithms and AI, with practical experience in building models and creating scalable solutions.
    You are as up to date with modern AI tools and are familiar in using LLMs in your Data Science Practice
    You are innovative, collaborative and can apply Data Science principles and techniques to create novel products and business models within cross-functional teams.
    You are business oriented, able to see opportunities where AI can improve our products and services.
    You are flexible and comfortable with change.

Day-to-day work & projects cooking

The challenge you can turn into an opportunity!

How do we make agentic products work well for users and customers? Which surfaces and problems are AI systems best equipped to solve? What new business opportunities have we neglected, because they were not technologically possible before?

The work we do here is far from trivial, which means that you have an opportunity to do your best work and create something new and amazing.

A few words from the hiring manager

Hi, I’m Vilde, and I manage the Data Science team in dAI. The team consists of 5 Data Scientists, including you, who work alone or in pairs in projects to develop AI-native products for our marketplaces. We come together to discuss approaches and applications, and we develop Data Science courses and workshops for other people in the company. Something exciting about us is that we love change, and we follow the biggest opportunities - the department itself will wind down at the end of 2027, and we strongly expect to find new homes for the roles in the business units. Data Science is an important and strategic capability for Vend.

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 27th of September. We will review applications on a rolling basis, appreciate and encourage earlier applications.

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer

IVRS (Integration, Verification, Release and Support) is a department within Grid Integration Modular Advanced Control (GI MACH), working with securing the quality of the MACH platform, the brain of the HVDC station. As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in automating and scaling the infrastructure that powers this platform, with extra focus on our internal applications and tools.

How You’ll Make an Impact

     Design, develop, and implement mission-critical tools and applications to support a scalable, high-performance, high-volume production environment with global users.
     Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ and C# development environments, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, MS Build scripts, Python and build systems.
     Automate infrastructure and software processes using tools like Ansible or Terraform.
     Manage containerized environments using Docker or Podman including creating and testing Windows and Linux images.
     Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting systems using tools like Sensu, Splunk, Logstash or Nagios.
     Plan and execute software and infrastructure upgrades based on data-driven capacity planning.
     Manage configuration, variants, and version control using Git, TFVC, and release management tools like Jira.
     Streamline development experiences for teams by designing scalable CI/CD processes and optimizing workflows with containerization and virtualization.
     Collaborate with teams to support business needs and provide domain expertise for internal systems.

Your background

     Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
     Expert skills in Linux, networking, storage, and virtualization.
     Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python. Shell and Golang beneficial.
     Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and experience designing pipelines using GitHub or GitLab.
     Familiarity with build systems (Makefiles, CMake) or Bazel and release management tools (e.g.: Git).
     Ability to manage software and infrastructure upgrades with a focus on scalability and performance.

jobs.title: Project Manager to the Center for Security and Resilience at SSE
jobs.description:
The Center for Security and Resilience is seeking a motivated and organized Project Manager who can take ownership of projects from initial concept and planning through implementation, evaluation, and continued development. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with a wide range of stakeholders and combining strategic development with hands-on execution.

A key part of the role involves planning and delivering both academic and practitioner-focused events, as well as recruiting and engaging students and hourly employees for various projects and assignments.

About the Center for Security and Resilience

Building security through competitiveness. In a world shaped by disruption, agile competitiveness is increasingly central to national and global security. The Center for Security and Resilience (CfSR) brings together academia, business, and government to explore how societies can grow stronger in preparing for and managing crises and war.

About the Role

As Project Manager, you will have broad responsibility for planning, coordinating, and delivering activities at the Center for Security and Resilience. You will oversee projects as a whole, create structure, and ensure that objectives are achieved on time and within budget.

You will work closely with students, partner organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. The role includes both independent work and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. You will report to the Executive Director of the Center for Security and Resilience.

Your primary responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

    Managing projects from start to finish, from needs assessment and project planning through implementation, monitoring, and evaluation
    Planning and delivering seminars, conferences, workshops, networking events, and other activities
    Recruiting, onboarding, and coordinating research assistants for various projects and assignments
    Developing clear processes for recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and event management
    Creating project timelines, assigning responsibilities, preparing budgets, and establishing monitoring procedures
    Coordinating participants, speakers, vendors, and partner organizations
    Preparing information, instructions, and other materials for projects and activities
    Ensuring a professional participant experience before, during, and after each event or activity
    Reviewing existing processes, documenting outcomes, and developing improved ways of working based on feedback
    Contributing to the development of the Center’s operations, procedures, and long-term partnerships

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is proactive, solutions-oriented, and skilled at bringing structure to projects with many moving parts. You take ownership of your work and can shift between long-term planning and hands-on tasks as needed. You are organized and structured in your work, while remaining flexible, service-oriented and confident in leading, coordinating, and supporting others to achieve shared goals.

To succeed in this role, you should be a clear, confident, and engaging communicator who can build trust, align stakeholders, and translate complex information into practical guidance for different audiences.

Requirements:

    A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience
    Experience independently planning, managing, and completing projects
    Experience organizing events, large-scale programs, or similar activities
    Experience recruiting, staffing, or coordinating employees, students, or volunteers
    Strong administrative skills and ability to create structure, manage details, and keep projects organized and on track
    Experience developing and quality-assuring procedures, instructions, and work processes
    Swedish and English

Meritorious:

    Experience working with student programs, professional development, training initiatives, digital learning platforms, or topics related to security, emergency preparedness, and resilience is a plus

What We Offer

At the Center for Security and Resilience, you will have a varied role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to influence how the Center and its projects develop. You will work in an environment where knowledge, civic engagement, and practical implementation come together, with students and external stakeholders serving as key partners.

Other:

This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is located in Stockholm and start date according to agreement.

Please be aware that we conduct background checks on final candidates for this position.

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

jobs.title: Applied Physicist at CERN
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As an Applied Physicist, you will join the ATLAS Group at CERN and be part of the team which is working on the upgrade of the muon spectrometer of the ATLAS detector. In this upgrade you will play a crucial role, leading the electronics integration in the new RPC detectors to be used in the Inner layer of the Barrel Muon Spectrometer.

An important part of the job will be the installation and commissioning of the new detectors in the ATLAS cavern. Your experience in commissioning and operations of gaseous detectors will be a strong asset which coupled with your versatility, and strong team spirit will be essential to the success of the ATLAS muon upgrade program.

Your responsibilities:
-Testing and validating pre-production Front-End, Low Voltage, and connection boards.
-Coordinating quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities.
-Supporting the integration of electronics boards into RPC detectors.
-Participating in QA/QC testing of fully equipped chambers.
-Debugging of problematic chambers.
-Coordinating testing before and after installation.
-Acting as the main contact between the RPC project and Technical Coordination during installation.
-Coordinating detector commissioning after installation.

Your profile:
-Strong experience in the design, debugging and operations of fast electronics boards for gaseous detectors.
-Demonstrated experience in operating and commissioning of gaseous detectors.
-Knowledge of gas detectors physics.
-Ability to work effectively in small to medium-sized teams under a leadership role.
-PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics or a related field.

Your skills:
-Design and simulation of front-end electronics for analog sensors and transducers.
-Knowledge and application of gas based particle detection technologies.
-Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.
-Analysis and optimisation of detector performance,
-Assembly and integration of detectors,
-Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
-Produces workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.
-Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
A valid driving licence.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
