jobs.title: Instrument Project Planner
jobs.description:
As an Instrument Project Planner, you will create the conditions needed for work to be carried out efficiently - from breaking down work orders and assessing resource requirements to coordinating dependencies, following progress in the field and managing changes along the way. This role suits someone with experience from heavy or highly regulated industry, a solid understanding of instrumentation and the confidence to independently drive their area of responsibility forward.

About the position:

As an Instrument Project Planner, you will be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of instrument-related work within a large-scale industrial project.

Much of your focus will be on reviewing and preparing the work orders included in the project. You will define the scope, break the work down into executable activities and ensure that technical documentation, resources and dependencies have been identified. This can include coordinating requirements for electrical and mechanical work, scaffolding, insulation and other supporting activities needed to complete the instrument work.

An important part of the role is understanding what the work will actually require in the field. Your planning needs to consider site conditions, required competencies and resources, as well as the sequence in which different activities need to be performed. The resulting work packages will form the basis for both contractor procurement and subsequent execution.

As the project moves into execution, your focus will shift closer to the work taking place in the plant. You will coordinate assigned resources and contractors, follow progress and ensure that work is performed safely and according to plan.

At the same time, you need to be comfortable working in an environment where conditions can change quickly. A work area may become unavailable, additional repair needs may be discovered or resources may need to be reallocated. In these situations, you will assess the impact, reprioritize activities and coordinate with the relevant disciplines to keep the work moving forward.

Responsibilities:

    Plan and prepare instrument-related work orders and work packages
    Develop technical work descriptions for procurement and execution
    Ensure work packages are complete, accurate and executable
    Assess work scope, resource requirements and technical dependencies
    Coordinate supporting activities from disciplines such as electrical, mechanical, scaffolding and insulation
    Ensure planned activities are incorporated into the overall project schedule
    Coordinate contractors and assigned resources during execution
    Follow progress and ensure work is performed according to applicable safety requirements
    Replan and reprioritize activities when conditions change
    Manage discovery work as well as changes and additional work identified during execution
    Follow up completed work packages and coordinate handover for inspection and quality control
    Provide technical support and problem-solving throughout execution

Requirements:

    Technical knowledge and a good understanding of instrumentation
    Experience from major industrial projects, shutdowns or similar environments
    Experience with technical planning and coordination of industrial work
    An understanding of working within heavy, process-based or otherwise highly regulated industry
    The ability to assess the resources, activities and dependencies required to execute technical work
    The ability to independently manage and follow up your area of responsibility

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    Experience from turnarounds or major planned maintenance shutdowns
    Experience from refineries, process plants, pulp and paper, pharmaceutical manufacturing or other highly regulated industrial environments
    Experience combining technical planning with coordination or supervision in the field
    Experience managing contractors and coordinating work across several technical disciplines

To succeed in this role, you need to be self-driven and confident in your technical judgement. You should be able to understand a work scope, determine what is required to execute it and independently drive the next steps without relying on detailed direction.

You are structured in your planning but pragmatic when circumstances change. When unexpected issues arise, you can assess the situation, reprioritize and bring the right people together to find a way forward without compromising safety or quality.

The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, contractors and other parts of the project organization, so you should also be comfortable communicating clearly and coordinating people around a common plan.

Practical information:

Scope: Full-timeStart: As agreed within the scope of the project til the end of 2027Location: Nynäshamn Salary: Fixed monthly salary by agreement

This is a consulting assignment through Friday, meaning you will be employed by Friday and work on assignment with the client.

About Friday:

At Friday, we are passionate about helping you take the next step in your career in IT and technology, whether you are looking for your first job or already have a few years of experience. By listening to what you want and what motivates you, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.

We place great value on ambition and potential and actively promote unbiased recruitment, giving everyone an equal opportunity to succeed.  You can find us in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we hold more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with companies ranging from global corporations to innovative startups.

jobs.title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!

Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales - Cimatron
jobs.description:
Shape the global commercial direction of Cimatron and turn market insight into profitable growth. As Vice President of Sales, you lead the worldwide sales organization, strengthen direct and reseller channels, and build the capabilities needed to succeed in technically complex markets.

Joining us means stepping into a highly visible role withing a growing global business. You help strengthen customer loyalty, drive performance, and build a high-performing global sales organization. Here, you:

    Translate market shifts, customer needs, and data into decisive action.
    Lead global teams and establish consistent sales standards, workflows, and service practices across regions.
    Contribute to an innovative, performance-driven organization focused on customer success.

About the job

You lead the entire commercial strategy and execution for the Cimatron business globally. The scope includes revenue and profitability, market coverage, sales excellence, forecasting, reseller performance, and strategic customer relationships. You lead a geographically distributed commercial organization, collaborate closely with Cimatron leadership team, and report business performance, risks and strategic recommendations to the President of Cimatron.

Job responsibilities

    Define and execute a global sales strategy aligned with business targets, growth ambitions and clear returns on investment.
    Drive revenue and margin performance across all regions, maintaining a strong pipeline, reliable forecasts and disciplined commercial governance.
    Develop market coverage, segmentation and go-to-market models across direct sales and reseller channels.
    Lead, coach and develop regional sales leaders while shaping an organization equipped for current and future market needs.
    Act as executive sponsor for key customers, strategic accounts and major opportunities, supporting selected negotiations and enterprise deals.
    Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, Operations, Finance and HR to strengthen market execution, customer value and organizational performance.

Location and flexibility

The position offers a flexible location within Europe. Travel is expected to reach approximately 25–30% over time.

Your profile

You have extensive experience in international B2B software sales and a record of growing revenue in technically complex markets. Your background includes leading multi-regional organizations and turning market intelligence, sales performance, and customer insights into focused commercial action.

Your background includes:

    A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related field; an MBA is highly preferred.
    Extensive B2B sales experience within software, manufacturing, machine tools, cutting tools or a closely related environment.
    Proven leadership of multi-regional sales teams, including experience leading other leaders.
    Strong knowledge of CAD/CAM workflows, manufacturing processes, global market dynamics and CRM-supported sales management.
    Advanced analytical, forecasting and commercial planning capabilities.
    Fluency in English is required, while German language skills are an advantage.

Previous experience as a Sales Director, Regional Vice President or in an equivalent senior position is also preferred, as is experience with CAD, CAM or PLM sales.

Strategic and forward-looking, you lead transformation with integrity, resilience, and sound judgment. You lead by example, inspire trust, develop people, and set clear expectations while remaining adaptable in a fast-moving environment. Strong executive communication and cultural intelligence help you influence effectively and bring geographically dispersed teams together around shared priorities.

The team

You lead a global commercial organization of approximately 37 employees, including regional sales leaders and teams working across direct sales, reseller management, sales support, and customer service. Collaboration across regions, cultures, and functions are essential in this position.

Our culture

At Cimatron, we believe in fostering an inclusive, equal, and open-minded culture. We value diversity and strive to create a supportive environment where every team member can thrive. We offer competitive benefits and numerous career development opportunities. Are you intrigued? Visit our website or LinkedIn to get to know us further.  

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Taline Forsberg, hiring manager, taline.forsberg@cimatron.com

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter.

Send your application no later than September 23, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0096576.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max

Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.title: Aquaculture Technician  (Ref no: 454210)
jobs.description:
Working with a team of biologists and engineers, this challenging and demanding position requires the
selected candidate to work in the company's aquatic research facility based in Malta, the largest
private facility of its kind in Europe. The activities carried out at the facility include work on various
aquatic nutrition trials and health related experiments undertaken on a range of freshwater and marine
species of fish, shrimp and live feed; the technician would be involved in all aspects of the daily
operations as well as being involved in specific research assignments.

NOTE: All applicants must have an EU/EEA/UK passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with the required permits and have an excellent command of the English
language, written and spoken.  

Job description  
A position within the AquaBioTech Group has arisen for a suitably qualified person to work as an
aquaculture / aquatic technician on a variety of research projects at our R&D facility known as ABT
Innovia. The responsibilities of the selected candidate are defined as follows:

Key Accountabilities
. The work is focused on the wet-labs facility of AquaBioTech Group (ABT Innovia), with
primary duties on maintaining livestock and RAS systems. These tasks involve mostly feeding
and health monitoring of the livestock, RAS system maintenance, inspection and
housekeeping, monitoring water quality and experimental trials activities and reporting.
. Day to day coordination and execution of all national and international research projects that
the AquaBioTech Group and its partners are awarded, ensuring that all the research
contracts are managed and executed within the timeframes and budgets provided and all
deliverables are met. This includes ensuring that all SOP and required accreditations, such as
GLP and GMP, are achieved and maintained.
. Be involved in various aspects of the design, engineering and logistics of bringing a RAS
project through to installation and beyond.

Reporting directly to the R&D Facilities Manager, the position is demanding requiring a person who is
highly motivated, methodical and organised. The selected person must be prepared to work to very
tight deadlines in isolated and multi-functional projects and in conjunction with a team of international
staff. AquaBioTech Group has also been awarded, and is continuously seeking to win more, research
projects funded by local government and the EU.

Requirements
. The successful candidate is likely to have a good solid background in aquaculture sciences,
preferably with at least a B.Sc. level of education, although experienced technician candidates are
also encouraged to apply. Experience in laboratory operating procedures and GMP and GLP is
also a bonus, but not essential as all training in these procedures will be provided.
. The selected candidate will be required to speak and write English fluently, and knowledge of any
other languages would be considered an asset, although not essential.
. The selected candidate must have a clean EU / EEA passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with no travel restrictions or legal convictions and be in possession of
a clean driving licence.

Training provided
Successful candidates will go through our internal onboarding procedure, whereas all information and
documentation will be provided before start date, for information and signing.

Any assistance with accommodation/relocation
AquaBioTech Group offers all employees company accommodation, which comes at cheaper rates
compared to personal renting, and which will be available immediately for new employees to use upon
their arrival. All preparation related to accommodation is handled by the company.

Salary
Euro 17,500 to Euro 19,000 per year.

The successful candidate will be offered a long-term, fixed-term contract with the company. The
starting package offered for this position will be structured largely upon the chosen candidate,
reflecting the experience the candidate brings to the company, but also in line with the cost of living in
Malta and could include an accommodation package, if required.

How will the interviews be held  
Both online and in-person interviews will be held, depending on the location of the individual.  

To apply
CVs and a covering email are to be sent by email to eures.recruitment.jobsplus@gov.mt and should
be written in English. Please quote the vacancy name and number (Ref no: 454210) in your email.

jobs.title: Chemical Engineer at CERN
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team developing the next generation of high-performance superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities. In this role, after dedicated training in the team, you will develop and optimise advanced surface treatments essential to their performance, including chemical polishing, electrochemical polishing and electroplating. You will also contribute to the design, procurement, commissioning, and acceptance of a new surface treatment facility dedicated to SRF components.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop, operate and optimise chemical and electrochemical surface-processing techniques for SRF accelerating cavities and their subassemblies.
- Optimise existing processes by developing and conducting laboratory-scale chemical and electrochemical trials, applying multiphysics simulation tools to improve process performance and reproducibility.
- Define technical requirements and coordinate the design, procurement, testing, commissioning and acceptance of new equipment and facilities for the chemical and electrochemical surface finishing of SRF components.
- Develop, validate, document and implement operating procedures, process specifications and quality control methods for the surface finishing of SRF components.
- Work closely with engineers, physicists, technicians, safety specialists and external suppliers, communicating results and technical recommendations through reports, reviews and project meetings.
- Ensure that all necessary safety measures and documentation are kept up to date and effectively implemented across existing and new processes and facilities.

Your profile:
- Strong background in applied electrochemistry and corrosion.
- Field experience in modelling, simulation, developing and optimising chemical or electrochemical treatment processes.
- Good knowledge of chemical engineering unitary operations and chemical process safety.
- Familiarity with electrochemical characterisation techniques.
- Knowledge of materials science, covering both organic and inorganic materials.
- Knowledge of wet surface finishing processes and initial practical experience would be considered an asset.
- Knowledge of metallurgy would be considered an asset.
- Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Knowledge of electrochemistry, corrosion and protection.
- Knowledge of metals and alloys: composition, structure, properties, heat treatments.
- Knowledge and application of thermodynamics and energetics.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in fluid mechanics and/or heat transfer.
- Contributes to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addresses issues.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Works conscientiously and reliably; delivers on promises.
- Actively promotes safety and encourages others to do the same; respects safety rules and procedures.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Medical hazard
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician at Cern
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing more efficient superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities for future CERN accelerators. In this hands-on role, after dedicated training in the team you will contribute to the improvement of thin-film coating technologies through the design, fabrication, commissioning and operation of physical vapour deposition (PVD) equipment.

Your responsibilities:
- Design mechanical components and coating equipment using 3D CAD tools and produce the associated manufacturing and assembly drawings.
- Assemble, install, test, commission and operate physical vapour deposition coating systems and their associated equipment.
- Manufacture and modify metallic and ceramic components using conventional machining and computer numerical control (CNC)-based manufacturing techniques.
- Participate in coating activities, record operating parameters and document process procedures.
- Procure mechanical components for thin-film coating systems.
- Diagnose faults, carry out maintenance and implement mechanical improvements to existing coating systems.
- Apply the relevant safe.

Your profile:
- Experience in conventional and CNC machining operations, particularly milling and turning.
- Experience using 3-dimensional computer-aided design 3D CAD software and interpreting technical drawings.
- Experience in the assembly and testing of ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems would be an asset.
- Basic knowledge of vacuum thin-film coating techniques would be an asset.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.
- Manufacturing of mechanical parts.
- Installation and commissioning of vacuum systems.
- Production and analysis of thin-film coatings.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
- Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

jobs.title: Financial Controller

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. - Experience with Apache Airflow, React and TypeScript, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch would be an asset.

Your skills:
- Development of application software, design, development and maintenance of production software applications, APIs and data processing workflows using Python and Django.
- Knowledge of programming techniques and languages, strong knowledge of Python, software engineering principles, API development, relational databases and modern development practices.
- Architecture and design of ICT systems, designing maintainable and scalable software architectures, integrations and data intensive applications.

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

jobs.title: Ski service / Ski Technician
jobs.description:
Description of the employer:
Norefjell Skisenter is a ski resort located at Norefjell in Krødsherad, Norway. The resort offers alpine skiing, ski school, ski rental, ski service, ski shop and various guest services and activities during the winter season.

The ski resort employs seasonal and permanent staff across several departments, including ski instructors, ski rental, ski service, ski shop, lift operations, restaurants and guest services. The resort welcomes both Norwegian and international guests throughout the winter season and operates with varying staffing needs depending on guest numbers and seasonal demand.

Job description:
The Ski Technician is responsible for the maintenance, preparation and servicing of skis and snowboards at Norefjell Skisenter. The position involves working primarily in the ski service workshop and handling both the resort's rental equipment fleet and guests' personal equipment.

Main duties and responsibilities:
- Maintain, repair and prepare alpine skis and snowboards for daily use.
- Perform machine and manual ski servicing, including base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and polishing.
- Prepare and maintain the resort's rental ski fleet to ensure that equipment is safe, functional and in good condition.
- Carry out repairs and adjustments to skis, snowboards and bindings within the scope of the position.
- Perform regular inspection and maintenance of rental equipment.
- Service guests' skis and snowboards according to their requirements and the ski service's quality standards.
- Operate and maintain ski service machinery and workshop equipment.
- Identify damage, wear and technical issues and determine the appropriate service or repair.
- Ensure correct handling and preparation of ski and snowboard equipment before it is returned to guests or placed back into the rental fleet.
- Follow safety procedures and manufacturer recommendations when working with machinery and equipment.
- Keep the workshop clean, organised and efficient.
- Provide professional customer service and explain completed services and recommended maintenance to guests when required.
- Cooperate with the ski rental, ski shop and other resort departments.
- Assist with other operational tasks within the ski service department when required.

The position requires good technical understanding of skis and snowboards, attention to detail and an interest in ski equipment and maintenance. Previous experience from a ski workshop or ski service department is preferred. Experience operating professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

The position is seasonal and primarily involves working during the winter season. Working hours may vary from week to week depending on guest numbers and whether the resort is operating during peak or low season. Weekend and public holiday work may be required.

Work experience:
Previous experience from a ski workshop, ski service department or ski rental is preferred. Experience Wintersteiger machines, base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and ski repairs is an advantage.

Technical skills:
Good understanding of alpine skis, snowboards, bindings and related equipment. The candidate should be able to identify damage and wear and carry out appropriate maintenance, repairs and adjustments. Experience operating and maintaining professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

Language:
Good English communication skills are required in order to communicate with colleagues and international guests. Norwegian or other European languages are an advantage.

Certificates and qualifications:
Relevant ski technician or ski service qualifications are an advantage. Training or certification related to machinery operation, workshop safety or equipment maintenance is also beneficial.

Other skills:
The candidate must be precise, quality-oriented and able to work independently. Good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently during busy periods are required. The candidate must also be service-minded and able to cooperate well with colleagues across different departments.

Additional information:
Norefjell Skisenter can assist with accommodation and rental arrangements. All seasonal employees also receive free access through the toll road to and from the mountain, as well as free parking.
All seasonal employees are also provided with a season pass and employee discounts at the ski shop, ski rental, and restaurants such as Skistua and NON at Norefjell Ski & Spa.

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
jobs.description:

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.description:

As a Delivery Manager, you will ensure smooth execution of technical deliveries by maintaining structure across tasks, builds, and milestones, while acting as a key coordination point between engineering, QA, and stakeholders. This is a hands-on role combining delivery coordination, build and deployment execution, and technical troubleshooting. You will work closely with teams to ensure builds are consistently delivered, tested, and available for review, while keeping communication clear and expectations aligned across all parties.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Delivery & Coordination

    Participate in internal and external meetings to capture requirements, decisions, and action items.

Technical Execution

Work with existing tools and pipelines to:

Communication & Stakeholder Support

    Translate technical progress into clear, structured, and actionable updates.
    Ensure alignment of expectations between technical teams and stakeholders.
    Support transparent and consistent communication across all involved parties.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

    Strong hands-on technical background (software, tools, or build systems relevant to the team).
    Experience with build systems, deployment workflows, or CI/CD pipelines.
    Ability to set up, run, and test builds independently.
    Comfortable working with existing tools and adapting to new ones quickly.
    Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
    Professional proficient in spoken and written English (knowledge of English is required, as the company is international and it is necessary to communicate in English with foreign colleagues daily).
    Excellent organization and task-tracking abilities.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Comfortable working across disciplines (engineering, QA, stakeholders).
    High attention to detail and follow-through.
    Proactive, self-driven, and reliable.

NICE TO HAVE

    Experience in game development, software delivery, or technical production roles.
    Familiarity with Agile or iterative development workflows.
    Previous experience acting as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
    Basic scripting or automation experience.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

    Monthly salary from 3700 EUR to 5500 EUR gross/per month.
    Health insurance from the first day of employment.
    Paid parking next to the office as required.
    On-site work model: 5 days from the office.
    Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development.
    Taking part in creating studios as part of an award-winning iGaming business.
    Truly international experience and collaboration possibilities with impactful results.

    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
jobs.description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

You will help shape the next generation of normal-conducting accelerator magnets for the Future Circular Collider (FCC), from design and prototyping through industrialisation and system integration. Working with CERN teams and industrial partners, you will develop scalable manufacturing and procurement strategies and apply lessons learned from the testing, maintenance and renovation of existing accelerator magnets to the development and delivery of reliable, cost-effective FCC magnet systems.

Your responsibilities
Design and develop cost-effective normal-conducting magnet technologies for the FCC, from concept and modelling through prototyping and system integration.
Study and propose manufacturing and procurement strategies for FCC magnets, tailored to the scale of the project and targeting an efficient and effective production, installation and maintenance.

Your profile
Experience in the design or construction of accelerator magnets or comparable complex electromechanical equipment.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of mechanical or electrical engineering or a related field.

Your skills

Operation and maintenance of normal conducting magnet systems.

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

jobs.title: Zelfstandig werkende koks I
jobs.description:
DaDa Wan Leidschendam, gevestigd in het grootste winkelcentrum van Nederland zoekt jou!

Bij Dada Wan geniet je van “worldly food with small town prices”. Onze missie is om gasten te verwelkomen met heerlijke, wereldse gerechten tegen een betaalbare prijs.

Voor deze unieke locatie in Leidschendam, naast Den Haag, zoeken wij een kok die ons keukenteam wil komen versterken.

Wat neem je mee als kok?

1. Je voert voorbereidende werkzaamheden uit, waaronder het wassen van groenten, het snijden en fileren van zalm, en het snijden van lamskoteletten en rundvlees voor de bereiding van stoneplate-gerechten. Dit doe je samen met een keukenteam van circa acht collega’s, onder leiding van de chef-kok.

2. Je bereidt en maakt diverse gerechten, waarbij je tussentijdse kwaliteits- en hygiënecontroles uitvoert volgens de geldende richtlijnen.

3. Je maakt gerechten gereed voor uitgifte en voert hierbij een eindcontrole uit, waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers (of robots) de gerechten kunnen bezorgen.

4. Je plant de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en plaatst bestellingen voor voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers. Tevens controleer je de geleverde producten op kwaliteit en kwantiteit.

5. Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden van hulpkrachten, geeft instructies en stuurt waar nodig bij.

6. Voor sluitingstijd zorg je voor een schone werkplek, reinig je keukenapparatuur en -machines, en assisteer je eventueel bij het schoonmaken van de gehele keuken en het opslaan van geleverde goederen.

7. Je bent een echte teamspeler, stelt je flexibel op en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

8. Je draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit, denkt mee over optimalisaties en helpt bij het samenstellen en aanpassen van menukaarten, recepturen en bereidingsinstructies.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met kennis van basis kooktechnieken.

jobs.description:
**Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!**

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.

Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.

Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.

Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen


Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridityömallilla ja työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja oman alueen tarpeiden mukaan.

**Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus**

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Johdamme työyhteisöä yhdenvertaisesti ja kohtelemme kaikkia kunnioittavasti – emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Huolehdimme turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista sekä toimimme vastuullisesti kaikessa tekemisessä.

Meillä viihdytään – työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla ja arjessamme näkyy arvostus, luottamus ja yhdessä onnistuminen. jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst - Recouvrement & crédit H/F
jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Nous recherchons un·e Lead Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Recouvrement

Dans ce rôle, tu seras chargé·e d’orienter la stratégie de recouvrement B2C en te basant sur l’analyse de nos données client et des opérations de recouvrement.

Pour cela, il faudra mesurer l’impact des actions existantes, construire des rapports d’analyse et proposer des orientations stratégiques pour améliorer les taux de recouvrement et gérer le risque crédit.

Tu accompagneras les équipes Recouvrement et Finance dans leurs prises de décisions et d’amélioration des processus de recouvrement d’Octopus Energy France. Tu reporteras à la Manager Recouvrement et Risque-Crédit, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes recouvrement, ops et finance.


Tes missions :
  • Être moteur dans la mise en place de la stratégie et des priorités du recouvrement pour l’entreprise

  • Développer, maintenir et partager des reportings et des analyses data complexes en lien avec la dette, le recouvrement et plus largement la Finance pour Octopus Energy France 

  • Être force de proposition sur  la mise en place des processus de recouvrement et des mesures de prévention pour garantir une excellente expérience client (par ex. : adaptation de mensualité, échelonnement de dettes)

  • Optimiser les décisions de crédit à partir de la données (A/B tests de workflow, décision de seuils)

  • Modéliser la dette en collaboration avec les différentes équipes Finance en France et Groupe pour du provisionnement

  • Développer la collaboration étroite entre ton équipe et les équipes Data France, et intervenir dans les instances de reporting auprès du COMEX France et du Groupe.
    • Ce poste inclus également le management direct de 2 collègues, 1 Data analyst expérimenté et 1 data scientist : accompagnement quotidien, montée en compétences technique, évolution chez Octopus, etc.

    Profil recherché :
    Les essentiels :
  • Tu as un solide bagage en analyse et pilotage de données, comme Analytics Engineer ou Data analyst par exemple ; idéalement dans les secteurs de la finance ou de la Tech,
  • Tu as d’excellentes compétences sur la stack data moderne : Python, SQL, DBT, Git notamment ; tu sais utiliser ces outils pour développer des analyses complexes et proposer des recommandations stratégiques,
  • Tu as au moins une 1ère expérience en management direct,
  • Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve dans l’amélioration de tes reportings et des tes analyses
  • Tu t’appropries tes sujets et tu les fais avancer,
  • Tu sais gérer des projets impliquant de multiples équipes en interne,
  • Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données d’une manière générale,
  • Tu es capable de synthétiser des analyses de manière claire, en quelques slides ou lignes par exemple.
    • Les plus : 
  • Tu as une connaissances des sujets recouvrement / crédit ("plus" supplémentaire si c'est dans le secteur/contexte de l'Énergie),
  • Tu as une connaissance des environnements data/cloud (GCP), et des outils d'automatisation,
  • Tu as une connaissance du Machine Learning et de l’IA.

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
  • Tu aimes contribuer et faire avancer la stratégie d’une équipe
  • Tu es pédagogue et as envie de participer à la montée en compétences technique de ton équipe
  • Tu sais travailler de manière collaborative et avec différentes équipes
  • Tu es un·e problem-solver et tu fais avancer tes projets
  • Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve
  • Tu sais travailler en Français et en Anglais (niveau min C1), pour pouvoir communiquer avec nos collègues du groupe et d’outre-Manche 
  • Tu partages notre ambition de révolutionner le monde de l’énergie !

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

Procurement Analyst is a specialist analytical role responsible for developing pricing strategy, conducting commercial data analysis, and leading supplier negotiation and category sourcing strategy to support the profitable expansion of the business. Qualifications & Experience Third-level degree in Accounting & Finance, Commerce, Business Management, Economics, or a related discipline (essential). Proven ability to conduct commercial negotiation and develop sourcing strategy. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Profiel

  • Grondige kennis van transportprocessen en intermodaal containervervoer

jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Levi
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**
