jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers and Architects
jobs.description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Senior Software Engineers and Architects**

The Senior Software Engineers at Nolwenture are responsible for supporting both client and internal projects, playing to the individual's strengths within the project team – in the role of Lead Developer, Product Owner or Project Manager.

As a senior developer, you will work with modern technologies that are kept up-to-date by the entire team's contributions in order to keep our best practices current and ahead of the game. You will also support mid-level, junior and trainee level team members with their project tasks and broader learning and development.

You will work directly with our clients throughout the project lifecycle; gathering requirements, managing expectations, and helping to plan and coordinate delivery alongside the wider team.

For even more experienced and skilled candidates we also offer Architect level appointments.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- possess a strong understanding about software development

- have a desire to work on both web and mobile applications

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills; at Nolwenture we work very closely with our clients

- be comfortable working directly with clients and confident taking on light project management responsibilities (e.g. previous experience as a Scrum Product Owner or had Scrum Master duties or having run sessions on story mapping or requirement gathering)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new stuff and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools as part of our everyday workflow


We work with a variety of programming languages, but a JavaScript background will suit us well as we use a lot of NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native.

You will benefit from knowing additional languages (e.g. Swift, Kotlin and Python) and being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). A background in areas such as Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS, or other data visualisation and physics / simulations experience, DB (sql/postgres etc.), administration (DBA) is of interest to us too.

Furthermore, an interest or experience in AI/ML will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters ideally. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Research Assistant. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.
The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have an opening for a motivated Research Assistant to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

Performing laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering and characterization
Conducting cell culture, molecular biology, and gene editing procedures
Assisting in data collection and documentation
Maintaining laboratory records and inventories
Supporting laboratory organization, equipment maintenance, and general operations
Collaborating with researchers and other team members in ongoing projects

Qualifications

The successful candidate holds a relevant degree in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field and has practical laboratory experience, particularly in cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
Immunology
Molecular biology
Gene editing technologies
GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive individual with a strong interest in laboratory-based research and development. They should be eager to learn new methods and technologies and possess excellent collaboration and communication skills.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of help with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we invest in the well-being of our personnel e.g. by offering a wide range of sports and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary for this position is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Terveyspalveluala. The position is classified in Salary Grade 4, with a base salary of EUR 2847,83 per month for a full-time employee. In addition to the base salary, remuneration includes a personal salary component, which incorporates a length-of-service guarantee.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, GLP/GMP-work, and gene editing, the duration of your experience with these techniques, and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).

jobs.title: Researcher
jobs.description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Researcher. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.

The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-NK and CAR-T cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have now an opening for a motivated Researcher to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

- Designing and conducting laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering

- Performing cell culture, gene editing, and molecular biology techniques

- Analyzing and interpreting experimental data

- Maintaining accurate experimental records and documentation

- Contributing to research planning, reporting, and scientific dissemination

- Collaborating with multidisciplinary research teams

Qualifications

The successful candidate preferably holds a PhD in a relevant field, such as immunology, cell biology, molecular biology, biotechnology, or a related discipline, and has substantial hands-on experience with cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

- Immunology

- Molecular biology

- Gene editing technologies

- GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above. The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive researcher with a strong interest in research and development and a willingness to learn new methods and technologies. Excellent collaboration, communication, and organizational skills are essential.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of helping with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. We also support your learning and development opportunities so that your skills remain up-to-date. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we support the well-being of our personnel by offering a wide range of exercise and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Developing the well-being of supervisors and work teams is also important to us. In addition, we invest in ensuring that everyone at the Blood Service has the opportunity to participate and influence the continuous improvement of our operations. Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

Our laboratory is located at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, Biomedicum 1, Helsinki. The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary is based on the contract salary system of the Blood Service. This position is placed in level 4, where the minimum salary is 3 722,68 euros. The salary is the minimum salary + 0-40 % depending on the person's skills, experience and the special characteristics of the position.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, gene editing, GMP-work, and bioinformatics that you master, the duration of your experience with these techniques and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).

Please submit your application through our electronic recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

jobs.title: Pædagog til Eventyrhuset - Børnehave i Dragør
jobs.description:
Brænder du for nærvær, fællesskab og faglighed?
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor du kan gøre en forskel - og samtidig have tid og rum til at udvikle din pædagogiske praksis? Så læs videre!

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog til vores børnehave i Eventyrhuset - en privat, integreret daginstitution i smukke Dragør. Hos os får du ikke bare et arbejde, men en arbejdsplads med hjerte, højt til loftet og stor mulighed for både medbestemmelse og udvikling.

Om Eventyrhuset

Eventyrhuset består af to afdelinger med i alt ca. 110 børn - ca. 44 vuggestuebørn og ca. 66 børnehavebørn. Vores personalegruppe tæller omkring 30 dedikerede medarbejdere: pædagoger, medhjælpere, køkkenpersonale, gårdmand og administration.

Eventyrhuset har som privat institution en institutionsbestyrelse med det øverste ansvar for driften, økonomien og personalet, samt en engageret forældrebestyrelse som sikrer forældrenes stemme i beslutningsprocesserne og står for de sociale aktiviteter som sommerfest, julefest mm.

Børnehaven - hvor tryghed, leg og læring går hånd i hånd

I vores børnehave er der tre grupper med, hver med en normering på 22 børn. Hver gruppe har en fast stab bestående af to pædagoger og to medhjælpere.

Vi prioriterer fællesskab og samarbejde - både mellem børn og voksne og på tværs af stuerne. Hos os kender alle børn alle voksne, og det giver en tryg og tillidsfuld atmosfære i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder løbende med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, og vi har et fælles fokus på relationer, nærvær og det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.

Din rolle som pædagog

Som pædagog i Eventyrhusets børnehave bliver du en del af en fast gruppe, hvor du - sammen med dine 3 stuekollegaer - får ansvaret for ca. 22 børn.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver tid og forberedelse. Derfor har du som pædagog hos os hver uge 2 timer afsat til "andet arbejde", som f.eks. planlægning, refleksion og dokumentation - uden børn.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer og faggrupper.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·       Har en uddannelse som pædagog.

·       Er professionel, omsorgsfuld og initiativrig.

·       Brænder for relationer, leg og nærvær i det pædagogiske arbejde.

·       Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

·       Har IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau (fordel, men ikke et krav).

Hvad får du hos os?

·       Mulighed for selv at vælge ugentligt timeantal.

·       2 timers forberedelsestid hver uge.

·       Betalt madordning med sund og lækker frokost.

·       Firma-betalt sundhedsforsikring - også for dine hjemmeboende børn.

·       Betalt ICDP-kursus, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet.

·       En hverdag i skønne omgivelser med masser af udeliv.

·       Et sted, hvor nytænkning og faglig udvikling er en del af kulturen.

·       Ingen lukkedage i sommerferien, så du er selv med til at styre hvornår du holder ferie.

Ansættelsesvilkår

·       Stillingen er på det antal timer, som passer dig bedst.

·       Start: Hurtigst muligt - men vi venter gerne på den rette.

·       Løn og vilkår efter overenskomst med BUPL og Børneringen.

·       Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og referencer som en del af processen.

Klar til nye eventyr?

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig på stillingen, så kontakt os endelig. Vi giver gerne en rundvisning, så du kan mærke stemningen selv. Du kan også læse mere om Eventyrhuset på vores hjemmeside: www.eventyrhuset.info.

Send din ansøgning og CV til post@eventyrhuset.info eller kontakt os på tlf. 28760260, hvis du vil besøge os først.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, og lukker annoncen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Eventyrhuset… Her bliver hverdagens øjeblikke til noget helt særligt

A Workplace Defined by Quality, Variety, and Team Spirit

On busy days, we can serve up to 1,200 guests across the Parliament's restaurants, cafés, and event venues. During elections, major political events, and special occasions, the pace increases and priorities can change quickly. This creates a dynamic and exciting working environment where flexibility and teamwork are essential.

You will become part of a team of more than 20 colleagues, including chefs, kitchen staff, waiters, and service professionals who work closely together to achieve a common goal: delivering outstanding dining experiences for our guests every single day.

Your Responsibilities

Who Are You?

You are a trained chef with experience from a staff restaurant, catering operation, large-scale kitchen, restaurant, or a similar environment. Above all, you have a genuine passion for food and enjoy working in a fast-paced and varied setting.

In addition, we are looking for someone who:

  • Is welcoming, service-minded, and professional when interacting with guests

  • Remains calm and adaptable when priorities change

What We Offer

We are looking for new colleagues to join us as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Ready to Join the Team?

Send us your CV today.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

Important Information

Please note that all employees working at Christiansborg Palace must be able to obtain the required security clearance.

jobs.title: Account Executive - French Speaking
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive - French Speaking based in France.

As an Account Executive, you will turn qualified product demonstrations into new, active, and transacting customers within a fast-growing global B2B marketplace. You will own the full commercial journey from discovery and demo through negotiation, contract closure, compliance, onboarding, and early customer activation. Beyond closing deals, you will be responsible for helping customers establish strong purchasing habits during their first 90 days. You will work closely with SDRs and Account Managers to ensure seamless handoffs and a strong customer experience. The role combines consultative selling, commercial negotiation, operational follow-through, and account activation. You will join a globally distributed sales organization where ownership, speed, customer relationships, and measurable results are highly valued.


Accountabilities
  • Run discovery-led product demonstrations that connect the marketplace's capabilities to each retailer's specific purchasing workflow, business needs, and commercial objectives.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from proposal and commercial terms through objection handling, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and contract closure.
  • Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and clearly communicate the value of broader supplier access, competitive pricing, product selection, and marketplace efficiency.
  • Drive KYC and compliance processes through to completion, proactively following up on documentation and resolving onboarding obstacles without losing sales momentum.
  • Own the customer journey throughout the first 90 days, helping new accounts move from initial searches and quotations to their first orders and repeat purchases.
  • Focus on customer activation and long-term value rather than simply closing and handing off newly signed accounts.
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure strong qualification and effective handoffs before and after demonstrations.
  • Coordinate with Account Managers to provide detailed account context, purchasing patterns, opportunities, and potential risks ahead of the day-90 transition.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline stages, activity records, and forecasts, ensuring commercial reporting reflects the true state of opportunities.
  • Monitor and improve key performance indicators including demo-to-close conversion, new business revenue, KYC completion time, 90-day activation, account value, and forecast accuracy.

    • Requirements

    • 3–6 years of proven experience in a closing sales role, ideally within a marketplace, transactional B2B/B2C platform, or the jewellery and diamond industry with meaningful commercial exposure.
    • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, including liquidity, supply breadth, customer trust, transaction mechanics, and the importance of driving an initial transaction to establish long-term purchasing behaviour.
    • Experience selling solutions based on customer workflows and business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led product presentations.
    • Excellent discovery, presentation, demonstration, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
    • Commercially minded and comfortable managing pricing discussions, contractual terms, and pushback from customers and multiple stakeholders.
    • Strong operational discipline and willingness to own post-sale activities such as KYC, compliance, onboarding, and activation.
    • Ability to manage a pipeline effectively, prioritize opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts in a fast-paced environment.
    • Customer-focused approach with the ability to build credible, long-term relationships with businesses of different sizes.
    • Strong ownership, resilience, adaptability, and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple deals and customer journeys.
    • Excellent communication skills in French and English, with the ability to communicate confidently with international customers and internal stakeholders.
    • Comfortable working independently in a globally distributed, low-hierarchy environment where initiative and measurable impact are highly valued.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours designed to support autonomy and effective performance.
      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Unlimited holiday allowance.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and skills development.
      • Opportunity to join a rapidly scaling global business during a significant phase of expansion.
      • Dynamic, collaborative, and intellectually challenging work environment.
      • Low-hierarchy culture with significant autonomy and ownership.
      • Opportunity to make a measurable impact on customer growth, revenue, and business scalability.
      • International and globally distributed team offering exposure to diverse markets and customers.
      • A culture focused on empowerment, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

jobs.title: Lindebjerg A/S søger en Mekaniker til teknisk klargøring
jobs.description:
VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF EN LANDSDÆKKENDE SUCCES?

Er du en praktisk anlagt person med hænderne godt skruet på – og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et stærkt team i vækst? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en effektiv og engageret mekaniker til vores afdeling i Middelfart, hvor du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer høj kvalitet i vores produkter – både før og efter levering til kunderne.

️ Hvad skal du lave?

Som mekaniker får du en alsidig hverdag med både klargøring og tekniske opgaver. Dine primære arbejdsområder vil være:

 

  • ✅ Reparation og servicering af kundescootere

  • ✅ Teknisk klargøring af nye og brugte scootere

  • ✅ Montering af ekstraudstyr

  • ✅ Kvalitetssikring og slutkontrol

  • ✅ Vedligeholdelse og orden i værkstedet sammen med dine kollegaer

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har teknisk snilde og evt. erfaring fra værksted eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og går op i kvalitet

  • Trives med både rutineprægede og varierende opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at tage fat, når der er travlt

Erfaring med el-køretøjer eller reparation er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af ansvar og variation

  • Et uformelt og hjælpsomt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og en arbejdsplads i vækst

  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en landsdækkende virksomhed med ambitioner

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV med billede til job@lindebjerg.dk. Skriv "Mekaniker" i emnefeltet.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler, så vi opfordrer interesserede kandidater til at søge snarest muligt.

Om Lindebjerg

DEN GODE SERVICE ER DET VIGTIGSTE FOR OS
Det er vores fornemste opgave at have tilfredse kunder. Dette opnår vi ved at sætte vores kunder i centrum ved altid at være service minded, have top engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, sælge kvalitetsprodukter, samt altid at være omstillingsparate, så vi kan tilpasse os vores kunders behov.

Lindebjerg er blandt landets absolut førende leverandører af el-køretøjer indenfor vores branche. Vi har solgt mere end 15000 køretøjer, som i dag kører på de danske landeveje.

Virksomheden er landsdækkende. Vores hovedkontor er placeret i Middelfart og lokationen råder over hele 2600 kvadratmeter fordelt på showroom, lager, værksted og administration. Udover vores hovedkontor, har vi showrooms fordelt i hele Danmark, derved kan vi altid være tæt på vores kunder. Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.

Hos Lindebjerg sætter vi en ære i at omsætte ideer til handling og sidder derfor også med helt fremme i bussen når det handler om at forretningsudvikle, inden for branchen. 
I dagligdagen tilbyder vi stor frihed under ansvar og vægter det sunde arbejdsmiljø og godt kollegaskab, i et uformelt miljø, højt.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

- Positiivisen ja viihtyisän asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen

- Työntekijöiden ohjaaminen päivittäisessä työssä

- Tavarankierron ja päivittäisten prosessien sujuvuuden varmistaminen

- Kuukausitilitysten laatiminen ja raportointi myymälätoiminnan esihenkilölle


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta asiakaspalveluun ja myyntityöhön

- Hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja

- Itseohjautuvaa ja vastuullista työotetta

- Positiivista asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kykyä toimia osana tiimiä ja ohjata päivittäistä tekemistä

- Kiinnostusta kiertotalouteen ja second hand -toimintaan

- Sitoutumista yhteisiin tavoitteisiin

- Valmiutta fyysiseen työskentelyyn


**Eduksi katsomme**

- Kokemuksen vaatemyymälän ylläpidosta

- Kokemuksen työntekijöiden ohjaamisesta tai tiimin vetämisestä

- Kokemuksen second hand -alalta

- Tietämyksen vaatemateriaaleista, tuotemerkeistä ja second hand -hintatasosta

- Sosiaalisen median osaamisen


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävänkuvan

- Lämminhenkisen työyhteisön ja ihanat asiakkaat

- Mahdollisuuden yhdistää kiinnostuksesi muotiin, kiertotalouteen ja hyväntekeväisyyteen

- Merkityksellisen työn osana Pelastusarmeijan auttamistyötä

**Tietoa Pelastusarmeijasta**

Työhön kuuluu mm. sosiaalinen apu, ruoka-apu, aikuisten harrastustoiminta, lasten ja nuorten kerhot, leirit, pyhäkoulu sekä hengelliset tilaisuudet. jobs.title: Purchaser
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by keeping materials moving, solving supply challenges and working closely with suppliers?

In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring material availability and reliable supply chain execution across Tanas operations.



Your responsibilities:

As a Purchaser, you are responsible for day-to-day operational purchasing. You ensure that materials and components are ordered, confirmed and delivered according to business needs, supplier agreements and production requirements.

You create, maintain and follow up purchase orders based on material demand, purchase requisitions, stock requirements and agreed supplier terms. You actively monitor supplier confirmations, delivery schedules and open orders, and work proactively to secure timely deliveries.

You also maintain accurate purchasing information in our ERP system and support the resolution of discrepancies between invoices, receipts and purchase orders.

You communicate regularly with suppliers to follow order status, delivery schedules, shortages, and possible changes. When needed, you coordinate corrective actions, identify delivery risks and escalate critical shortages, delays or supplier performance issues to the relevant stakeholders.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in operations, production, logistics, finance and other relevant functions, as well as with external suppliers. Through your work, you help ensure that information flows smoothly and operations can run reliably across the organization.



What we expect from you:

We are looking for someone with relevant education in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in purchasing, supply chain coordination, logistics, production planning or a similar operational role. You understand order-to-delivery processes and have basic commercial knowledge of prices, lead times and delivery terms.

Experience in ERP systems is required, and previous experience with NetSuite is considered a strong advantage. Experience in heavy machinery, industrial equipment, manufacturing or a similar operational environment is strongly preferred.

You work systematically and accurately, but you are also able to react quickly and prioritize when urgent material needs or delivery challenges arise. You communicate confidently with suppliers, take ownership of open issues and approach problems with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

Success in this role also requires strong cooperation skills and the ability to work effectively with different functions and stakeholders. Fluency in written and spoken Finnish and English is required.



What we offer:

You will join a professional and collaborative Operations team where your work has a direct impact on material availability, operational continuity and the reliability of our global supply chain.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your purchasing and supply chain expertise in an international technology company. You will work with a broad supplier network and collaborate across functions, giving you a comprehensive view of Tanas operations and supply chain.

Our working culture is down-to-earth and pragmatic, with a strong focus on openness, cooperation and getting things done together. At Tana, you will contribute to solutions that improve efficiency in waste management and support a more sustainable future.

If you are ready to take on an important role in operational purchasing and help us build a reliable, responsive supply chain, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä, other locations negotiable.



For more information, please contact Henrik Häggblom, VP Services & Operations, tel. +358 40 75 19027, during the following times:

Friday 11th September 12:00-13:00, Monday 14th September 12:00-13:00 or Tuesday 22nd September 13:00-14:00.



Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 27 September 2026. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.




Tana Oy

TANA From Waste to Value®

Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

jobs.description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Hotellet kan från sensommaren 2026 även stoltsera med sitt egna bryggeri.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 25 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en pigg och glad kollega till vår restaurang och bar.

Vi söker dig som brinner för öl och utöver servering i bar, restaurang och konferens även kan bistå vår bryggtekniker vid ölprovningar. Tids nog ser vi gärna att du även kan hålla egna provningar. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- Servera

- Kassahantering

- Blanda drinkar

- Bistå vid och även hålla ölprovningar

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med servering. Du behöver kunna svenska och engelska. Finska är mycket meriterande. Du behöver vara minst 20 år gammal samt ha alkopass/serveringspass.

Tjänsten är på hel- eller deltid hos oss på Park Restaurang & Bar. Serveringsjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med kvällspass under veckans alla dagar. Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a transformative journey to decarbonize the maritime industry?
We are looking for a Process Engineer willing to mix creativity and engineering skills to develop design of fuel systems for the marine industry.
The preferred location for this position is Vaasa (Finland) but also Helsinki, Turku (Finland), Trieste (Italy) are negotiable.

Your role and responsibilities
As a Process Engineer you will have the possibility to follow the entire lifecycle of our products from initial design to operational support through manufacturing, installation and commissioning at shipyard.
Your work will mainly focus on engineering solutions for fuel supply systems for LNG, Methanol and Ammonia.
You will be responsible of the design of piping & instrument diagrams (P&ID) and defining process equipment (pumps, heat exchangers, compressors etc.). You will also be responsible for creating thermodynamic and pressure drop calculations/simulations, developing operating procedures and other supporting technical documents for the fuel supply system.
In this position you will be part of an international team working in close collaboration with other engineering disciplines as well as with customers, classification societies, suppliers and other stakeholders. Youll also have the opportunity to play an active role in the constant development activities for the fuel supply systems for all the fuels.

Requirements for the position:
* MSc in Chemical and Process Engineering or Energy Technology
* Knowledge of the marine/shipbuilding industry is seen as an advantage
* Experience with AutoCAD
* Experience with Process simulation software (AspenTech, MATLAB, AFT Fathom)


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:
* Good technical knowledge and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently
* Responsible, flexible, proactive, stress-resistant and planning skills
* Fluency in the English language, both written and verbal
* Good communication and collaboration skills


The primary location for this role is Finland but this role can also be based in Italy where the annual salary range would be 27 887 EUR – 39 270 EUR , depending on seniority, and in accordance with the salary provisions in the National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico). At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. This range reflects the expected compensation for the role, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary offered will depend on factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience. We also take internal equity into account to ensure fairness across our organisation.

Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline 22nd of September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

jobs.title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland

**Application deadline:** 24.9.2026

Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?

**What will you be doing?**

SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.

A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.

The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.

Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.

**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**

You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.

We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.

**We hope you have:**

- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work.

- Experience with electrical motors, coils, wires, electrical components, or similar industrial equipment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials.

- Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services.

- Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English.

- Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style.

- Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities.


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly.

- Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods.

- Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services.

- Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production.

- Experience in international manufacturing environments.

- Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation.


**What SpinDrive offers you:**

- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications

- Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality

- Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks

- Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe

- Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition

- The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth.


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible, but the latest in November 2026.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher in synthesis and analysis
jobs.description:
The University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en), founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research. The university has an international academic community of 40,000 students and staff members. The Department of Chemistry (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science/faculty/chemistry) at the Faculty of Science (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science) carries out research on chemistry and its applications at an international level and provides academic teaching based on high quality research.
The Department of Chemistry invites applications for one
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER
position in Synthesis and Analysis. The successful applicant will join the developing research group at the Department of Chemistry. The position is fixed-term for 12 months with a possible extension. Employment starts as soon as possible.

Position description
The postdoctoral position funded by the Research Council of Finland aims to design closed-loop dissolution/activation laboratory and scaled-up methodologies for recycling platinum group metals and rare-earth elements using green chemicals energy- and resource-efficient approaches - including organometallurgy and mechanochemistry - complying with sustainable development, resource safety and circular economy. This interdisciplinary project lays on the interface between coordination chemistry, metal dissolution and organometallurgy, organic chemistry, methodology development and mechanochemistry. Postdoctoral researchers tasks will include the development of recycling protocols for different metals, advanced characterization of the reaction mixtures and obtained isolated materials. The work will also comprise help in the supervision of undergraduate, graduate and visiting students. The researcher is expected to present their findings in scientific meetings, prepare funding applications for travel and research grants, as well as prepare manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. The position has a trial period of 6 months.

Requirements
Motivated, ambitious and self-driven candidates with a PhD degree in a relevant field (chemistry or related) interested in metal recycling are encouraged to apply. Experience in the fields of coordination complex chemistry, molecular metal compounds, homogeneous metal catalysis, organic synthesis, mechanochemistry of metals, as well as experience in analytical techniques including NMR, PXRD, HRMS and ICP-MS/AES are advantageous. Most importantly, you should have strong motivation for research in a highly multidisciplinary topic, enthusiasm to learn new things and contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research team. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. We will offer a meaningful, original and ambitious scientific project in an international, top-level research environment. From the applicant we expect high motivation to conduct demanding experimental work, as well as a curiosity driven science-enthusiastic mindset.

Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (requirement level 5). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* a CV with a list of publications,
* a brief description of your research interests (1 page) with clear indication on the motivation to apply for this position,
* a copy of a PhD degree certificate.

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
The deadline for applications is October 8th, unless the right candidate is found before. Interviews will commence right away, already during the application period.

Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Research Council of Finland Fellow, Dr. Anže Zupanc (anze.zupanc@helsinki.fi). For more information on Dr. Zupancs publications, see Anže Zupanc (0000-0002-3697-7839) - ORCID and Anže Zupanc - Google Scholar.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.

In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities include:
- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.
- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.
- Using Matlab & Simulink for simulation and building test benches.
- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.
- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.

You are offered...
- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.
- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.
- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.

We are looking for

We value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.

Requirements:
- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.
- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).
- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab & Simulink.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).
- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).

We appreciate if you'll have...
- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.
- Familiarity with the power electronics industry

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Wärtsilä: Development Specialist / Manager (Supply Chain data)
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time - Fixed term, 12 months

**Location:** Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku

**Application deadline**: 20.9.2026

Interested in using data to improve supply chain processes? Join Wärtsilä Energy to develop reporting, data solutions and smarter ways of working across supply chain management.

**Key responsibilities**

In this position, your focus will be on developing more data-driven ways of working within Wärtsilä Energys Supply Chain Management organisation, particularly in procurement and strategic sourcing. You will work hands-on with data and Power BI, develop reports and data products, define KPIs and help improve how supply chain data is structured and used.

You will work closely with supply chain professionals and data specialists to develop ideas further and turn business needs into practical data solutions. You will coordinate development projects and explore how new tools, including AI and intelligent agents, could support supply chain processes. You will be supported by Wärtsiläs data experts on more technically demanding topics, but you are also expected to be a hands-on contributor who develops solutions and drives improvements from idea to implementation.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You are a proactive and curious person who enjoys working with data, learning new topics and finding better ways of doing things. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing structure to development work and moving things forward independently. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and are willing to test and learn when working with new tools and topics. You are also comfortable coordinating projects and keeping development work moving forward in collaboration with others.

**What we are looking for:**

- Several years of experience in project coordination or development work

- A relevant academic background in engineering, supply chain, business or a similar field, combined with an understanding of supply chain processes

- Hands-on experience with data, reporting and Power BI

- A proactive, independent and analytical working style with the ability to structure information and drive improvements forward

- Good communication and collaboration skills in English


**Additionally valued:**

- Previous experience working with procurement, purchasing or strategic sourcing, as it will help you understand the business context and related data

- Experience with automation and AI solutions, intelligent agents or applying AI in a business environment

- Familiarity with SAP, Salesforce, Databricks or other ERP and data platforms

- Good skills in Finnish


**We can offer you:**

- Broad opportunities to build expertise by working with supply chain, procurement, data and digitalisation professionals

- Versatile responsibilities where you can develop new ways to use data across supply chain management and turn ideas into practical improvements

- A truly international working environment where you will get to collaborate with a variety of colleagues from different departments

- An opportunity to continue discussions of future employment before ending the 12-month period

- Good introduction to Wärtsiläs operations and processes, helping you understand development needs and contribute to meaningful improvements


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 12 months, where you will join Wärtsilä Energy as aTalents employee. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible.

Your immediate team is split between Helsinki and Vaasa, but you can be based in Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku. Wärtsilä offers a flexible hybrid working model, and we hope you can work from the office regularly.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner (Lyon, France)
jobs.description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

jobs.title: MAG-hitsaaja, Kaarina
jobs.description:
VPS Yhtiöihin kuuluva VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu on vuodesta 1987 lähtien toiminut, henkilöstövuokraukseen ja rekrytointiin erikoistunut yritysketju, jonka kattavuus on koko Suomi. Olemme Henkilöstöala HELA ry:n jäsenyritys. VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu on sitoutunut laatuun ja asiakaspalveluun, tunnuslauseemme on VALITSEMME PARHAAT SINULLE. Lisää yrityksestämme www.vps.fi -sivuilla.

 

Nyt haemme metallialan asiakkaalle Kaarinaan kokeneita MAG-hitsaajia teollisuuden teräsrakenteiden hitsaukseen. 

 

Odotamme hakijoilta kokemusta MAG-hitsauksesta, huolellista työotetta ja hyvää piirustustenlukutaitoa.

 

Arvostamme itsenäistä työskentelyotetta ja suoritettuja hitsauspätevyyksiä.

Tehtävässä tarvitaan vuorotyövalmiutta ja hyvää fyysistä kuntoa.

 

Eduksi hakijalle on alan ammatillinen koulutus. Työpaikalla pärjäät, jos sinulla on hyvä suomen- tai englanninkielentaito. 

 

Huomioimme haussa myös vastavalmistuneet. Tässä mahdollisuus pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen!

 

Täytä hakulomake oheisesta linkistä pikaisesti, käsittelemme hakemuksia sitä mukaa kun ne saapuvat. Voit halutessasi liittää lomakkeeseen vapaamuotoisen hakukirjeen ja ansioluettelon. Hakuun liittyvät kysymykset p. 02 527 8900 tai sähköpostitse salo@vps.fi. Mikäli olet jo täyttänyt VPS:n sähköisen hakulomakkeen, käy liittämässä se tunnuksillasi tähän paikkaan.

 

* * * * *

 

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu, a member of VPS Group, has been operating since 1987 and is a chain of companies specializing in labor hire and recruiting services, with coverage throughout Finland. We are a member company of the Employment Industry Finland, HELA. VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu is committed to quality and customer service, our motto is WE CHOOSE THE BEST FOR YOU. Find out more about our company on our website .

 

We are currently seeking experienced MAG welders for an industrial client in Kaarina to weld steel structures.

 

We expect applicants to have experience with MAG welding, a meticulous approach to work, and good blueprint-reading skills.

 

We value an independent work ethic and existing welding certifications.

 

The role requires a willingness to work shifts and good physical fitness. Vocational training in the field is considered an advantage. Proficiency in Finnish or English is required to succeed in the job.

 

We also welcome applications from recent graduates. This is an opportunity for long-term employment!

 

Please fill out the application form via the link provided as soon as possible; we process applications on a rolling basis. You may also attach a cover letter and CV to the form. For inquiries regarding the position, please call 02 527 8900 or email salo@vps.fi. If you have already filled out VPSs electronic application form, please log in and attach it here.

jobs.title: Piccoline søges til international virksomhed i Aarhus – 20 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i Aarhus søger FIRMAVIKAR en serviceminded og ansvarsbevidst piccoline til et deltidsvikariat på 20 timer om ugen.

Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed og får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du hjælper med både praktiske og lettere administrative opgaver på kontoret.

For den rette kandidat er der mulighed for fastansættelse hos virksomheden.

Om jobbet

Som piccoline er du med til at sikre, at kontoret fungerer godt i hverdagen. Du vil have kontakt med forskellige kolleger og skal være typen, der naturligt tager fat og hjælper, hvor der er behov.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Lettere kontor- og administrative opgaver

  • Klargøring og oprydning i forbindelse med møder

  • Sørge for, at kontor og fællesområder fremstår pæne og ryddelige

  • Praktiske opgaver i løbet af arbejdsdagen

  • Diverse ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er serviceminded, imødekommende og har en positiv tilgang

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er mødestabil, punktlig og struktureret

  • Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner

  • Taler og skriver både dansk og engelsk

  • Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-værktøjer som Microsoft Office og Excel

  • Har gode organisatoriske evner og sans for detaljer

  • Er fleksibel og hjælper til, hvor der er behov

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Aarhus
Arbejdstid: 20 timer om ugen inden for tidsrummet kl. 09.00–15.00
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Ansættelse: Deltidsvikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse

Vi tilbyder

  • Et deltidsvikariat på 20 timer om ugen

  • Faste og gode arbejdstider

  • En alsidig arbejdsdag i en international virksomhed

  • Et professionelt og godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode kolleger og ordnede forhold

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse for den rette kandidat

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, så send os dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi gennemgår ansøgningerne og afholder samtaler løbende, da stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja, Tanssittava
jobs.description:
**Liikunnanohjaaja, Tanssittava**

**Tanssittava etsii uusia liikunnanohjaajia joukkoonsa!**

Tanssittava on kasvava tanssi- ja liikuntastudio, joka tarjoaa monipuolista ja helposti lähestyttävää toimintaa eri-ikäisille harrastajille. Toimimme useilla toimipisteillä **Pirkanmaalla** ja tunneillamme käy viikoittain satoja harrastajia. Toimintaperiaatteemme perustuvat sensitiivisyyteen, ja toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja ovat yksilöllisyys, laadukkuus sekä asiakkaidemme kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Etsimme joukkoomme **ammattitaitoista, innostavaa ja luotettavaa liikunnanohjaajaa.**

**Opetustunteja tarjolla**

Tarjoamme **sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo heti**, joten ohjaamisen voi aloittaa nopeasti. **Vakiintuneempia viikoittaisia tunteja on tarjolla tammikuusta 2027 alkaen.**

Ohjaustunteja on tarjolla pääasiassa **iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin**. Tunteja on mahdollista tarjota myös aamu -ja päiväaikaan.

Etsimme monipuolisia liikunnanohjaajia, joilla on osaamista esimerkiksi ryhmäliikunnasta, kehonhuollosta, liikkuvuudesta, pilateksesta, joogasta, tai toiminnallisesta harjoittelusta. **Myös muiden lajien ja tuntikonseptien osaaminen kiinnostaa!** Jos sinulla on mielessäsi laji tai tuntikonsepti, jota Tanssittavan valikoimassa ei vielä ole, kerro siitä rohkeasti hakemuksessasi.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa osaamista omalta lajialaltasi

- aikaisempaa kokemusta ryhmien ohjaamisesta

- innostavaa ja kannustavaa ohjaustapaa

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- halua kehittää omaa ohjaamistaan ja Tanssittavan tuntitarjontaa


**Tarjoamme**

- sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo syksyllä 2026

- mahdollisuuksia vakiotunteihin tammikuusta 2027 alkaen

- ohjaustunteja iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

- mahdollisuuden ehdottaa ja toteuttaa uusia lajeja ja tuntikonsepteja

- joustavuutta tuntimäärien ja opetuksen suhteen

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana kehittämässä kasvavan studion toimintaa

- mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi, koulutuksestasi, ohjauskokemuksestasi ja omasta osaamisestasi.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös:

- mitä lajeja tai tuntikonsepteja haluaisit ohjata

- milloin olet käytettävissä

- mahdolliset omat laji- tai tuntikonseptiehdotuksesi


Hakemukset lähetetään osoitteeseen toimisto@tanssittava.fi

**Haku päättyy 1.11. tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Tervetuloa mukaan Tanssittavan kasvavaan yhteisöön!

Engineering Manager - Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions)
Tanssinopettaja, Tanssittava
jobs.description:
**Tanssittava etsii uusia tanssinopettajia joukkoonsa!**

Tanssittava on kasvava tanssistudio, joka tarjoaa laadukasta ja helposti lähestyttävää tanssinopetusta eri-ikäisille harrastajille. Toimimme useilla toimipisteillä Pirkanmaalla ja tunneillamme käy viikoittain satoja tanssijoita. Toimintaperiaatteemme perustuvat sensitiivisyyteen, ja toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja ovat yksilöllisyys, laadukkuus sekä asiakkaidemme kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Etsimme joukkoomme **innostavia ja luotettavia tanssinopettajia.**

Tehtävä

Tanssinopettajana suunnittelet ja toteutat omat opetustuntisi sekä vastaat ryhmäsi laadukkaasta ohjaamisesta. Opetusta on tarjolla sekä **päivä- että ilta-aikaan**.

Toivomme sinulta

- aikaisempaa kokemusta tanssinopetuksesta

- kykyä kohdata eri-ikäisiä ja tasoisia harrastajia

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- innostavaa ja kannustavaa asennetta

**Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi**, sillä opetusta järjestetään useilla toimipisteillä Pirkanmaan seudulla. **Kerrothan hakemuksessasi, onko sinulla auto käytössä.**

Tarjoamme

- monipuolisia opetustunteja eri-ikäisille harrastajille

- mahdollisuuksia opettaa sekä **päivä- että ilta-aikaan**

- joustavuutta tuntimäärien ja opetuksen suhteen

- mahdollisuuden opettaa useilla Tanssittavan toimipisteillä Tampereen seudulla

- mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana kasvavassa tanssistudiossa


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi, tanssitaustastasi ja opetuskokemuksestasi.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös:

- mitä tanssilajeja haluaisit opettaa

- millaisia ikäryhmiä haluaisit opettaa

- milloin olet käytettävissä

- **onko sinulla auto käytössä**


Hakemukset lähetetään osoitteeseen toimisto@tanssittava.fi
