Tervetuloa mukaan Tanssittavan kasvavaan tanssiyhteisöön!

jobs.title: Staffing Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: No Fixed Place, Ireland. Salary: €52,500 per annum. Contract: Full-time, 12-month Fixed Term Contract. Monday – Friday (with flexibility to attend events) About the Role We are looking for an experienced and proactive Staffing Manager to lead the attraction, recruitment, onboarding and deployment of high-volume workforces for a major event. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic workforce planning with hands-on recruitment delivery. You will be responsible for ensuring staffing requirements are met, compliance standards are maintained and workforce plans are delivered efficiently to support business growth and operational excellence. Working closely with operational leaders, HR teams and external partners, you'll play a key role in building engaged, high-performing teams that deliver exceptional service. What You Will Be Doing Recruitment & Workforce Planning Lead end-to-end recruitment campaigns across operational, management and specialist roles. Build and maintain talent pipelines to meet the business needs. Develop attraction strategies using job boards, social media, networking and community partnerships. Forecast staffing requirements and support workforce planning activities. Manage agency relationships and recruitment suppliers. Onboarding & Compliance Ensure all recruitment activity complies with employment legislation and company policy. Oversee Right to Work documentation, references and pre-employment screening. Maintain accurate employee records and workforce data. Support audit and compliance requirements across the recruitment lifecycle. Training & Employee Experience Coordinate onboarding and induction programmes. Support completion of mandatory training requirements. Work with stakeholders to identify workforce development needs. Champion a positive candidate and employee experience. Operational Support Collaborate with business leaders to deliver workforce plans effectively. Monitor staffing levels and proactively address resourcing challenges. Support mobilisation activities of the event contract. Provide recruitment insight, reporting and recommendations to stakeholders. Financial Management Manage labour forecasting and workforce budgeting activities. Monitor recruitment spends and identify cost-saving opportunities. Produce regular staffing reports and onboarding metrics. What We Are Looking For Essential Previous experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, staffing or workforce planning. Strong understanding of Irish employment legislation. Experience managing high-volume recruitment campaigns. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong organisational and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and recruitment systems. Desirable Experience within hospitality, events or other large-scale operational environments. Experience working with large temporary or casual workforces.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case:

211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

jobs.title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.

We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.

Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor and full professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here:

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen .

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad.

Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:

    • Please describe and document international network and relations

    • Please describe and document internationally based activities

    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark

    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media

    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.

  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans

  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:

    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students

    • Teaching experience

    • Formal pedagogical training

  • Complete publication list

  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers

Applying for the associate professorship or full professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding

  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans

  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines

  • Complete publication list

  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers

The deadline for applications is 27 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

jobs.title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
jobs.description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing

Den ledende graver skal varetage følgende opgaver på vore tre kirker i Tvede, Linde og Mellerup samt sognehuset og arealerne omkring præstegården i Tvede.
  • Varetage og være ansvarlig for kirkegårdenes og præstegårdsarealernes vedligeholdelse, gravfæstelser m.m.

  • Varetage indledende registrering af gravsteder, opdatere gravstedsbreve, legater og udskrive fakturaer
  • Udføre kirketjeneste ved kirkelige handlinger på skift og sammen med gravermedhjælper
  • Samarbejde med øvrige kirkelige myndigheder
  • Varetage periodevis rengøring af kirker og kontorer m.m.
  • Bistå præster og samarbejde med andre ansatte med løsning af diverse opgaver omkring kirkelige arrangementer

Vi forventer at du:
  • Er pligtopfyldende, effektiv og mødestabil
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også indgå i fælles opgaver og samarbejder
  • Kan tilrettelægge opgaver og administrere arbejdstiden over hele året
  • Kan håndtere diverse små maskiner, flere arbejdssteder og mangeartede opgaver
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat på kort tid til uforudsete opgaver
  • Er udadvendt og imødekommende for folk, der kommer på kirkegårdene
  • Har kørekort og kan stille bil til rådighed for kørsel mellem kirkegårdene
  • Kan medvirke ved afvikling af kirkelige handlinger
  • På alle måder har overskud til at skabe et sundt og godt miljø for graverteamet

Kirkerne har automatiske ringeanlæg.

Der er ikke krav om gartnerisk uddannelse, men det vil ses som en fordel.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO-S samt organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver og det tilhørende protokollat for gravere.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 1, hvis der ikke er gartnerisk uddannelse.
Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 342.523 kr. - 421.573 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).
Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 2, ved gartnerisk uddannelse.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 350.435 kr. - 438.259 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Der ydes rådighedstillæg efter gældende overenskomst. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 16.297 - 27.246,56 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026)
Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Pension kommer oveni efter overenskomstens bestemmelser.

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start, hvis uddannelsen ikke allerede er gennemført.

Ansættelse sker ved Tvede-Linde-Mellerup-sognes menighedsråd

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Er der spørgsmål vedr. stillingen, kan man rette henvendelse til menighedsrådsformand Laila Hjorth Fournais Clausen på tlf. 40105820

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes via ansøgningsknappen.

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde snarest og senest 20. sept 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact on businesses in developing countries and experienced in implementing security frameworks? Join our team as Senior Information Security Specialist at Impact Fund Denmark (IFDK).

At IFDK, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh. 

 

Here is what you get with us

  • A leading role in shaping and strengthening our information security

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture 

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment 

 

The job

We are on a mission to continue strengthening our information security efforts.

Reporting to the SVP Technology & Operations, you will address critical security questions and strengthen the management of information security, incl. risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, building of awareness culture, and strengthening of detect, response and continuity capabilities. The information security effort has strong support from the board and executive management, emphasizing its business-critical nature.

You will work closely together with the Technology team to implement relevant security measures, and you will join an international organisation on a vital mission with a unique opportunity to elevate the organisation’s information security to the next level. Your contributions will be central to empowering IFDK to achieve its goals and successfully navigate the challenges of the future.

 

Main tasks and responsibilities

  • Threat & data management: Identify critical security risks and develop proactive strategies to manage and protect critical data.

  • Conduct risk assessments and report: Perform continuous risk assessments to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and present findings to executive stakeholders

  • Implement security controls: Deploy security controls to mitigate identified risks and continuously monitor the effectiveness of these controls to ensure they remain compliant and adapted to emerging threats.

  • Train and educate: Stay up to date with the latest security trends and facilitate ongoing training and awareness programs for all employees. Help ensure they understand their roles in the information security ecosystem to promote greater ownership and a security culture.

 

Your qualifications and experience

  • Experience from a position where you successfully have led complex changes or projects regarding cyber and information security – preferably within the financial sector e.g. as a consultant.

  • Knowledge of relevant legal and security frameworks e.g., ISO27001/2, DORA etc.

  • Relevant experience in information security management, risk assessment and executive security reporting

  • Relevant technical skills and knowledge about the Microsoft 365 security stack (Entra ID, Defender, Purview), security monitoring and incident response.

 

Personal competences

  • Independent, proactive and self-driven

  • Outgoing and a natural relationship builder 

  • Ability to communicate across levels, from technical to C-level

  • Positive team player

 

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact? 

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. Please submit it via the apply button today or no later than September 18th, 2026. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply. 

CVs not submitted via the apply button will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate. 

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's Development Finance Institution. We aim to be a best-in-class impact investor by making commercial private sector investments that support the green transition, as well as building just and inclusive societies in developing countries and emerging markets. Impact Fund Denmark has a strong focus on creating sustainable and responsible businesses, which generate measurable social, economic, and climate impacts as well as solid financial returns.

 

Ready to build the financial engine behind global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)

jobs.description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

 

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

 

Here is what you get with us:

  • A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development

  • Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team

  • The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:

  • Platform development: design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application

  • Web application development: design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs

  • Dynamics 365 configuration: configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence

  • Process automation: build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems

  • Backlog delivery: work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release

  • Requirements translation: engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs

  • Collaboration with external resources: coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase

  • Testing and release: support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation

  • Production support: troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use

  • Documentation: maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

 

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Technical foundation: have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Platform expertise: have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate

  • Web development skills: have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code

  • Dynamics 365 knowledge: understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles

  • Collaborative delivery: are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers

  • Communication: communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments

  • Problem-solving: take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application

  • Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform

  • Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications

  • Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus

  • Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:

  • Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)

  • Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)

  • Microsoft Power Automate

  • JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development

  • Dynamics 365 as a platform (excluding functionality requiring a Dynamics 365 Sales licence)

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system

  • Azure DevOps for backlog, source control, and release management

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

Ready to build the backbone of our investment, risk and finance operations?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
jobs.description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

How to Apply

Our recruitment partner Barona IT Talent will handle the application process and candidate communication. Please submit your application no later than 4th of October, 2026.

For more information, please contact:

Arja Martikainen, +358 40 7621564 (best reached Tue-Thu between 1-3 PM) or via emailat arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi

Please note: Background check may be a part of the recruitment process.

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement. Equally due to GDPR, please do not submit your application directly to recruiter email.

jobs.title: Maskinoperatør / Produktionsmedarbejder til CRH's fabrik i Roust
jobs.description:
Maskinoperatør / Produktionsmedarbejder til vores fabrik i Roust

Vil du have et job med gode fremtidsmuligheder, stærkt fællesskab og adgang til moderne maskiner og udstyr? Hos os får du en aktiv hverdag, hvor du kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt – og hvor sikkerhed og ordentlighed er en del af kulturen.

Du tilbydes

  • Et spændende job med gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • En aktiv hverdag med engagerede kollegaer og stærk holdånd
  • Personlig og faglig udvikling – bl.a. gennem videreuddannelse
  • En kultur præget af respekt, rettidig omhu og en uformel omgangstone
  • Fast stilling på timeløn og skiftehold (dag/aften/nat)
  • God løn, pension og sundhedsordning
  • Arbejdstøj og vask heraf, senest efter 4 ugers ansættelse

Dine opgaver

  • Du bliver en vigtig del af produktionen, hvor du sammen med dit team sikrer høj kvalitet og stabil drift
  • Betjening af belægningsstensmaskine
  • Truckkørsel (4-gaflet truck)
  • Kvalitetskontrol
  • Rengøring af betonblander og siloer samt oprydning i produktionen

Vi søger dig, som…

  • Har erfaring fra produktion og hænderne godt skruet på
  • Trives med fysisk arbejde
  • Er selvkørende og ikke bange for at tage fat
  • Besidder teknisk forståelse
  • Har viljen og lysten til at lære nyt
  • Er let omgængelig, pålidelig og mødestabil
  • Tager medansvar og bidrager til den gode stemning
  • Har truckcertifikat og kørekort B
  • Kan fremvise ren straffeattest

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en del af CRH – en international koncern – men i Roust er vi et lokalt team med stærkt sammenhold, uformel tone og fokus på sikkerhed. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi udvikler hinanden, og vi får tingene gjort.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet i Roust

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi holder samtaler løbende, indtil vi har fundet den rette.

Om CRH Products

CRH Products har ca. 150 medarbejdere på seks lokationer i Danmark og leverer alt fra fliser, belægning og støttemure til rør- og brøndsystemer, bygværker og plansiloer. Vi er en del af CRH i Danmark, der samlet har ca. 1.500 ansatte på 19 lokationer inden for råhusbyggeri, råstoffer, belægning og rørsystemer. Vores mål er at udvikle løsninger, der bygger, forbinder og forbedrer verden.

Læs mere på www.crhproducts.dk.

jobs.title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing.

  • Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données.

Développement de Produit :

  • Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering.

  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante.

  • Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations.

  • Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur.

Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle :

  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients.

  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

  • Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

  • Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe.

  • Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.


Ce que l’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

  • Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit.

  • Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets.

  • Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact.

  • Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

  • Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur.

  • Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue

    • Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS.

    • Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel.

    • Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs.

    • Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur.

  • Tu es bilingue Français / anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne.

  • Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde.

  • Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager.

  • Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation.

  • Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont écoutées et où l’impact individuel est réel.

  • Avoir la possibilité de délivrer rapidement de la valeur et de voir concrètement les résultats de son travail.

Poste ouvert en CDI et full remote.

jobs.title: Kiertävä lähihoitaja - määräaikainen, Attendo Oma, Oulun seutu
jobs.description:
Kiertävä lähihoitaja Attendo-koteihin ja kotihoitoon Oulun alueelle – Olemme täällä sinua varten!

Me Attendolla olemme Matkalla kodiksi. Se merkitsee sitä, että haluamme olla ennen kaikkea koti ikäihmisille, vammaisille ja vammautuneille sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille. Viimeisten vuosien aikana olemme onnistuneet johtamiseen, asiakaskokemukseen ja kohtaamisiin satsaamalla kasvattamaan niin läheis- ja asukastyytyväisyytemme kuin henkilöstötyytyväisyytemmekin historialliseen huippuun.

Jokainen asukkaamme ansaitsee tulla kohdatuksi omana itsenään ja elää täyttä elämää. Attendolaisena olet tärkeä osa tätä tehtävää.

Oulun alueella on 6 ikääntyneiden, 6 kehitysvammaisten ja 6 mielenterveys-ja päihdekuntoutujien Attendo-kotia, sekä kotihoidon palvelut. Tutustu Oulun alueen Attendo-koteihin: Attendo-kodit [https://www.attendo.fi/yksikot/?culture=fi&ancestors=26013&pageSize=20&take=0&pageIndex=1&skipAmount=0&root=348689&contentType=contentType-0&currentPageId=26577&location=Oulu]

Voit olla vasta valmistunut tai jo kokenut konkari. Pääasia, että teet työtäsi iloisella ja avoimella mielellä. Kiertävänä lähihoitajana tärkeintä on joustavuus ja rohkeus tarttua toimeen.

Meillä on mukava ja rento kiertävien hoitajien tiimi ja oman tiimin lisäksi saat kuulua kiertoalueen Attendo-kotien tiimeihin.

Attendo Oma-tiimiläisten tehtävänä on olla aina siellä missä tarve on sillä hetkellä suurin. Sinulle nimetään alueelta kotiyksikkö, jossa olet silloin kun sijaistukselle muualla ei ole tarvetta.

Palkkaus sisältää kiertävän työntekijän tehtäväkohtaisen lisän 337,11 e/kk, sekä maksamme verottoman kilometrikorvauksen työajoista. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen määräajalle 31.12.2027 saakka, aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on pääsääntöisesti kaksivuorotyötä.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan työvuoroihisi – autonominen listojen suunnittelu tukee työhyvinvointia ja arjen sujuvuutta.

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkintoa (lähihoitaja)

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Hygieniapassi

* Rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan työsuhteen alkaessa

* Sote-ammattikortti eli varmennekortti

* Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus

* Sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomenkielentaitoa, vähintään tasolla B1.1.

Lähihoitajat ovat sydämellisiä tiimityöskentelijöitä, jotka tarttuvat rohkeasti toimeen ja innostuvat uusista ideoista. Asiakaslähtöisyys, ystävällisyys ja vastuuntuntoisuus kuvaavat hyvin näitä hoiva-alan rautaisia ammattilaisia. He ottavat itsenäisesti vastuuta ja tuovat positiivista, avuliasta energiaa tiimeihimme.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi

jobs.title: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

  • Velholdte lastbiler

  • Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:
job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

  • Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

We Expect You To:

  • Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

  • Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

  • Be reliable, independent, and responsible

  • Be physically fit and able to handle freight

  • Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

  • Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

➕ It Is an Advantage If You:

  • Have experience with distribution driving or similar transport work

⭐ We Offer:

  • A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

  • Well-maintained trucks

  • Thorough training in routes and procedures

  • Good colleagues and an informal working environment

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Interested?

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@naka.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and to a successful future collaboration.

There are 2 vacancies available.

jobs.title: AJUDANTE DE COZINHA

Ajudante de Cozinha
Descrição da Função
O CRAPP_Centro de Relevância Alzheimer e Parkinson Portugal procura Ajudante de Cozinha para integrar uma equipa comprometida com a excelência dos cuidados, a segurança alimentar e a promoção da saúde e qualidade de vida dos residentes.
A função envolve apoio à preparação e confeção de refeições, higienização de equipamentos e instalações, receção e armazenamento de géneros alimentares, empratamento, distribuição de refeições e colaboração no cumprimento dos procedimentos de higiene e segurança alimentar.

No CRAPP, a alimentação é entendida como parte integrante do cuidado terapêutico. O profissional contribuirá diariamente para garantir refeições seguras, equilibradas, nutritivas e adaptadas às necessidades específicas de pessoas com demência, Parkinson e outras condições associadas ao envelhecimento.

Procuramos pessoa responsável, organizada, dinâmica e com genuína motivação para trabalhar numa instituição dedicada ao cuidado de pessoas idosas e em situação de fragilidade.
Valorizamos experiência em cozinhas institucionais, IPSS, ERPI, hospitais, unidades de cuidados continuados ou restauração coletiva, embora não seja fator eliminatório.

Competências Requeridas
Sentido de responsabilidade e compromisso com a qualidade do serviço prestado;
Capacidade de trabalhar em equipa e colaborar com os restantes profissionais da instituição;
Conhecimentos básicos de higiene e segurança alimentar;
Capacidade para cumprir normas, procedimentos e orientações técnicas;
Organização e método na execução das tarefas diárias;
Capacidade de manter elevados padrões de limpeza e higiene dos espaços e equipamentos;
Atenção ao detalhe e rigor no acondicionamento e conservação dos alimentos;
Capacidade de gestão do tempo e de adaptação a ritmos de trabalho exigentes;
Disponibilidade para horários rotativos, fins de semana e feriados, quando aplicável;
Boa capacidade física
