jobs.title: Land Development & Field Clearing Manager
jobs.description:
**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

Lead the first physical execution phase of the programme: land preparation, field clearing and efficient recovery of biomass generated during clearing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Prepare clearing and land-development plans.

· Tender and manage clearing and earthworks contractors.

· Plan heavy-equipment fleets and production rates.

· Organise biomass recovery, sorting and transport to biochar plants.

· Maintain biomass and timber mass balances.

· Prepare cleared land for the following cultivation phase.

· Control clearing cost per hectare and contractor productivity.

· Ensure environmental, community and HSE requirements are met.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CAPABILITY**

· Experience in major earthworks, forestry, agriculture, land development or infrastructure projects.

· Strong knowledge of heavy equipment and field productivity.

· Demonstrated site-management experience.

· Ability to manage contractors in remote and developing-site conditions.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

· Tropical or West African project experience.

· Biomass recovery / forestry logistics experience.

· ESG-sensitive land development experience.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES**

· Safe hectares cleared to plan.

· Biomass recovery rate and cost per hectare.

· Land handed over on time for cultivation.

**RECRUITMENT PRINCIPLE**

We are looking first and foremost for hands-on implementers with a proven record of taking real industrial or infrastructure projects from planning through procurement, construction, commissioning and operation.

The roles are part of an international renewable-energy, circular-economy, biorefining and industrial side-stream utilisation investment programme with Côte dIvoire as the principal implementation country. The portfolio includes both fast-start production projects and later large-scale industrial investments.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

A reasonable level of working English is essential. French language skills are a major advantage.

**EXPECTED WORKING STYLE**

· Practical, decisive and delivery-oriented.

· Fact-based, using measurable results and documented data.

· Prepared to challenge supplier assumptions and verify operating references.

· Able to work in a multicultural environment and build local capability.

· Understands that pilot testing, customer qualification and phased scale-up are central risk-management tools.

**EMPLOYMENT AND LOCATION**

Employment form, work location and travel requirements will be defined role by role. Some positions may begin in Finland or elsewhere in Europe, but several key roles will require significant presence in Côte dIvoire during implementation phases.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: VVS-Montør søges
jobs.description:
Erfaren VVS-montør søges

Vil du være en del af en veldrevet virksomhed med høj faglighed, stor frihed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

Niels Mølgaard ApS søger en dygtig og engageret VVS-montør, der er klar til nye udfordringer og ønsker at blive en del af et professionelt team med fokus på kvalitet, service og godt håndværk.

Trives du i en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, ansvar og tæt kontakt til kunder? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen

Med reference til afdelingslederen bliver du en del af en veletableret og dynamisk VVS-installationsvirksomhed, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er centrale værdier.

Hos os er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på godt kollegaskab, sammenhold, humor og en positiv omgangstone i hverdagen. Du får primært arbejdsområde i Aarhus og omegn, hvor du kommer til at servicere både private- og erhvervskunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med spændende opgaver inden for:

• Service- og reparationsarbejde for private kunder, erhvervskunder og boligforeninger

• Renoverings- og ombygningsprojekter

• Energioptimering og energirenoveringer

• Mindre entrepriser

• Fejlfinding, vedligeholdelse og kundeservice

Arbejdet udføres hovedsageligt i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og fast job i en solid virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• Stor grad af frihed under ansvar i et velfungerende team af kompetente og erfarne kolleger

• En flad organisation med kort vej fra idé til handling og solid administrativ opbakning i hverdagen

• Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, firmabil og smartphone til rådighed

• Moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, herunder komplet blikkenslagerværksted

• Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling gennem kurser og efteruddannelse

• Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt fællesskab

Vi forventer, at du

• Er uddannet VVS-montør og gerne kompetent erfaring

• Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

• Har fokus på kvalitet og god service

• Er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager positivt til teamet

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag

• Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

Tiltrædelse

Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@nmvvs.dk med emnet "VVS-montør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega hos Niels Mølgaard ApS.

Om virksomheden

Niels Mølgaard ApS er en familieejet virksomhed, etableret i 1984, og er i dag blandt Østjyllands førende specialister inden for VVS, energi og blik. Virksomheden løser opgaver for både private kunder, erhverv og entrepriser og har stor fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og godt håndværk. Med ca. 30 medarbejdere og løbende efteruddannelse af alle ansatte tilbyder Niels Mølgaard ApS et professionelt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. Virksomheden har adresse i Højbjerg ved Aarhus og omfatter desuden søsterselskaberne NME Ejendomsadministration og VVS-shoppen.dk

jobs.title: Rengøringstekniker søges
jobs.description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Mur- og facadebehandling, herunder afrensning og rengøring af forskellige overflader

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Julgestustöötaja-tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: öösiti

jobs.title: Ingénieur procédés analytiques H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

- Partage de connaissances : Former nos équipes aux techniques analytiques les plus avancées et apporter une expertise spécialisée en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique.

- Assurance qualité : Gérer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs de molécules et définir les protocoles de qualification en étroite collaboration avec le service Qualité.

- Interface internationale : Servir de point de contact analytique et technique auprès des laboratoires internationaux d'Air Liquide (notamment Fremont et Dallas) pour des études de corrélation stratégiques.

- Leadership et amélioration continue : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue en faisant preuve d'une force de proposition affirmée, notamment en matière de sécurité, et en assurant un management transversal efficace.

english version :
- Following an internal mobility within the company, we are seeking a Process Engineer Analytics (m/f) for our laboratory.
- Join the laboratory team to play a central role in the analytical excellence of our Electronics business, a rapidly expanding sector. Your key responsibilities will allow you to be at the forefront of innovation and expertise.
- Drive Analytical Innovation: Lead strategic analytical developments and the qualification of new molecules, thereby ensuring the reliability of our products.
- Cutting-Edge Expertise: Lead developments in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography, specifically for organosilicate and organometallic molecules.
- Knowledge Sharing: Train our teams on the most advanced analytical techniques and provide specialized expertise in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography.
- Quality Assurance: Manage the qualification of new molecule suppliers and define qualification protocols in close collaboration with the Quality department.
- International Interface: Act as the analytical and technical point of contact with Air Liquide's international laboratories (notably Fremont and Dallas) for crucial correlation studies.
- Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute to continuous improvement, demonstrating a strong proposal-making capacity, particularly regarding safety, and ensuring effective cross-functional management.

jobs.title: Data Governance Consultant / Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for our current client a Data Governance Consultant / Project Manager in HR Data Domain.

Full-time position until end of year, continualtion very possible. 3 days a week in Helsinki, rest remote. Finnish language is not mandatory.

Responsibilities:
 Plan, phase, schedule, and coordinate the HR data domain takeover project with the HR domain and project team
 Facilitate definition of the HR data domain scope, entities, common language, semantics, and business concepts
 Facilitate definition of minimum AI-ready data quality requirements and metadata standards for HR domain data
 Coordinate mapping and prioritization of physical HR data across systems and the overall data landscape
 Facilitate definition of controls that ensure AI-ready content at data creation, together with a clear error-handling model
 Facilitate creation of the operational HR data domain governance model, including roles, responsibilities, decision-making, maintenance, prioritization, processes, and tools
 Run shared project tasks and collaboration across HR, Data & AI, and IT specialists
 Produce and maintain project documentation, plans, work breakdown, milestones, Gantt schedule, decisions, and status reporting

Must-have skills: 
 Strong project management and facilitation skills in a corporate environment
 Practical understanding of data governance and data domain operating models
 Ability to plan and drive a cross-functional project, including work breakdown, phasing, milestones, Gantt schedule, dependencies, and shared team actions
 Ability to facilitate data domain scope, entity, concept, semantic, and business definition work without taking ownership of business decisions
 Understanding of data and IT landscapes, metadata, documentation, data quality, controls, and issue management
 Ability to translate between HR/business, Data & AI, and IT stakeholders
 Strong documentation, communication, and concise progress-reporting skills
 Proactive, structured, and hands-on working style

jobs.description:
Emploi Pédodontiste H/F - Vauréal 95

Nous recrutons un pédodontiste H/F en salariat pour intégrer une structure dentaire moderne située à Vauréal (Val-d'Oise).

Description et missions
Vous exercerez en tant que pédodontiste exclusif ou en bénéficiant d'une formation approfondie en orthodontie, selon votre projet professionnel. Vous rejoindrez un environnement favorisant une prise en charge optimale des jeunes patients, avec un support clinique et administratif complet : assistante dentaire dédiée au fauteuil et équipe de secrétaires assurant la gestion des rendez-vous et du suivi administratif. La structure garantit un flux constant de nouveaux patients, assurant un agenda bien rempli.

ADN de la structure
La clinique bénéficie d'infrastructures modernes, récemment rénovées, et dotées de technologies de pointe : Invisalign Diamond Provider, scanners de dernière génération, panoramique, cone beam et céphalométrie. L'équipe est composée de 10 assistantes dentaires et 5 secrétaires, assurant une gestion fluide et efficace. Les praticiens bénéficient également d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour leur installation et leur évolution professionnelle.

Rémunération

jobs.title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Arval
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced lawyer with a generalist mindset? Are you ready to join a Nordic in-house legal team as its sole lawyer based in Finland?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Arval** as a new **(Senior) Legal Counsel**!

**_Arval, BNP Paribas Group Company,_** _was founded in 1989 as a specialist in full-service vehicle leasing and new mobility solutions for its customers, ranging from international groups to smaller companies and individual retail clients. More recently, Arval has diversified its business to become a key player in integrated mobility, addressing a wider audience that includes drivers and private individuals. Arval has over 8600 employees operating in 28 countries with over 1,800,00 leased vehicles._

**As BNP Paribas's in-house lawyer**, you will advise Arval's Nordic business, with focus on Finland. This is a versatile role, and your responsibilities will cover the following areas:

- **Contractual matters:** You will draft and revise contracts with a focus on operational leasing, consumer law, public procurement, insurance distribution, and competition law and data protection.


- **Contract negotiations:** You will support in contract negotiations with customers, partners and suppliers.


- **Ongoing legal support:** You will support particularly Finnish business units in all legal matters (excluding tax and employment law). You will identify and assess legal risks, advise the business on legal matters, and provide regular training.


- **Template updates:** You will develop and maintain legal templates and other documentation.


- **Regulatory monitoring and risk mitigation:** You will monitor applicable legal and regulatory changes and assist in mitigating any resulting legal risks, including by ensuring necessary revisions to legal documentation, policies, and procedures.


- **Strategic legal development:** In addition to day-to-day operational work, you will manage legal projects and contribute to group-wide legal initiatives.


While your primary focus is to support Arval's business units, you will also regularly assist the Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) business line of BNP Paribas. You will spend approximately one working day a week in the BNP Paribas Helsinki office, offering legal support to the CIB business line in the Nordics. This will include advising on transactional matters as well as legal and regulatory projects. You will work closely with the CIB Legal Nordics team and other Nordic legal teams of BNP Paribas Group and business partners assisting them with legal advice linked to Finnish operations.

This position will be mainly based at Arval Finland's office in Vantaa, and you will report to the Regional Head of Legal Nordics Arval, based in Stockholm. BNP Paribas's branch office is in Helsinki city center. Based on Arval's hybrid model, you can work remotely two days a week.

**You may be the person we're looking for if:**

- you have a Finnish Master of Laws degree and ideally 7 to 9 years of relevant professional experience working as an in-house legal counsel and/or at a law firm – international working experience and previous experience in an industrial environment or in finance is considered a plus;

- you are a generalist with a solid background within multiple legal areas and the ability to engage in new legal areas. Some of the areas of law for which we expect you to have solid background is contract and consumer law, public procurement as well as data protection. Experience in AML/CFT regulatory frameworks is a plus. Background in transactional and regulatory legal matters in the financial sector in Finland is an advantage but not a requirement. Ideally, you also have experience providing legal advice and assistance in insurance contract matters;

- you have an independent and solution-driven approach and a proven ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice;

- you are a collaborative team player with a strong sense of integrity;

- you have a strong analytical judgement and the ability to assess complex legal and regulatory matters; and

- you have great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish – knowledge in Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is considered a plus.


**Arval offers you:**

- a pivotal legal role with impact on business decisions: you will be a trusted advisor to management and key stakeholders in the Nordics;

- a role with a wide scope of legal matters across multiple areas and countries, along with opportunities for professional development;

- a high degree of autonomy and responsibility, along with a strong level of trust;

- a professional working environment with an international profile; and

- an inclusive and inspiring company culture with supportive colleagues and a great team spirit.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **20 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi).

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.

  • The rate of pay will be specified in the job offer

jobs.description:
Do naší party hledáme šikovného kolegu, který se nebojí vzít do ruky nářadí, přemýšlí technicky a má rád poctivě odvedenou práci. Pokud vás láká podílet se na vzniku strojů, které nejsou sériovou výrobou, ale originálním řešením pro konkrétní zákazníky, rádi vás poznáme.

Jsme rodinná firma zaměřená na vývoj a výrobu automatizovaných linek a jednoúčelových strojů. Pracujeme na projektech, které dávají smysl, a hledáme kolegu, který chce růst společně s námi.

Co bude vaším výsledkem práce?
Sestavené a funkční části strojů připravené pro oživení a předání zákazníkovi.
Kvalitně provedené montáže podle technické dokumentace.
Spolehlivě odvedené servisní a montážní práce u zákazníků.
Precizně opracované díly a komponenty připravené pro další výrobu (broušení, jehlení, řezání závitů apod.).

Koho hledáme?
Hledáme člověka, který:
má technické myšlení,
orientuje se ve výkresové dokumentaci,
rozumí mechanice a ideálně zná pneumatické prvky,
je manuálně zručný a pečlivý,
dokáže pracovat samostatně a dotahuje práci do konce,
vlastní řidičský průkaz skupiny B.

Co nabízíme?
Jednosměnný provoz.
Příspěvek na stravování a možnost stravování v závodní jídelně.
Práci na zajímavých zakázkách a unikátních strojích.
Přátelský kolektiv a zázemí stabilní rodinné firmy.
Možnost rychlého profesního růstu a dalšího rozvoje.

Pro koho je tato práce ideální?
Pro člověka, který nechce dělat stále totéž dokola, baví ho technika, rád hledá řešení a chce vidět konkrétní výsledek své práce.

Pokud jste se v tom našli, pošlete nám svůj životopis  a získejte možnost pracovat pro špičkovou firmu v oboru.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

Essentials

  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)

  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills

  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions

What we offer

Location and compensation

  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly

jobs.title: Kierownik (K/M) w Dziale Administracjii - nabór
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Zakres realizowanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. Kierowanie pracami Działu Administracji; dokonywanie podziału zadań
podległym pracownikom i ich nadzór.
2. Prawidłowe i sprawne wykonywanie zadań, przestrzeganie przepisów prawa oraz
porządku i dyscypliny w ramach kierowania działem.
3. Terminowość i rzetelność załatwianych spraw wynikających z realizacji powierzonych
zadań.
4. Racjonalne wykorzystywanie środków w ramach zatwierdzonych budżetów.
5. Kontrola prawidłowości zakupów, transportu i dostaw.
6. Przygotowanie okresowych ocen, analiz, informacji, i sprawozdań.
7. Kontrola rachunków pod względem merytorycznym za zrealizowane zlecenia,
zamówienia i umowy.
8. Coroczne określanie podstawy do naliczenia podatku od nieruchomości, oraz z tytułu
trwałego zarządu.
9. Nadzór nad brygadą remontową.
10. Monitorowanie wykorzystania kart drogowych przez pracowników Działu, oraz
prawidłowości rozliczenia kosztów eksploatacji pojazdów służbowych.
11. Wydawanie i podpisywania zaświadczeń w sprawach wynikających z działalności
Działu.
12. Wykonywanie innych zadań nie objętych zakresem czynności, a zleconych przez
Dyrektora MOPS.
Praca w systemie jednozmianowym w godz. 7.30-15.30 od PN do PT.
Umowa o pracę na czas określony 6 miesięcy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego z zastrzeżeniem art. 11 ust. 2 i 3 ustawy o pracownikach samorządowych.
2. Posiadanie pełnej zdolności do czynności prawnych oraz korzystania w pełni z praw publicznych.
3. Brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe.
4. Posiadanie wykształcenia wyższego.
5. Posiadanie minimum 4 lata stażu pracy w ramach umowy o pracę.
6. Koncepcja organizacji pracy Działu Administracji.
Wymagania dodatkowe związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Preferowane doświadczenie w pracy w obszarze administracji na stanowisku urzędniczym

jobs.title: OUTRO TRABALHADOR DE LIMPEZA MANUAL
jobs.description:
O grupo francês Saur International, referência na gestão sustentável da água, reforçou a sua presença em Portugal com a aquisição da CTGA e Enviman através da Aquapor, consolidando a sua posição de liderança em Portugal, apostando em soluções inovadoras nas áreas da engenharia hidráulica, sanitária e ambiental.

Junte-se a uma equipa sólida, com visão de futuro, e contribua para projetos que fazem a diferença.
Procuramos um Técnico Operativo de Desobstrução e Limpeza (m/f) para a Zona de Lisboa, destacando-se:

Principais responsabilidades:
- Condução das viaturas hidroaspiradoras;
- Transporte de lamas;
- Desobstrução de fossas;
- Trabalho conjunto com os Operadores de Infraestruturas de Água e Águas Residuais para limpeza das infraestruturas.

Requisitos Exigidos:
- Carta de Pesados (obrigatório);
- Interesse e motivação profissional;
- Residência: Lisboa centro e zonas limítrofes;
- Disponibilidade Imediata (preferencial).
- Capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal;
- Proatividade e capacidade de iniciativa;

Formalização das Candidaturas:
- Envio da referência do anúncio;
- Envio de Curriculum Vitae atualizado;
- Data limite 28/09/2026.
- Endereço eletrónico para entrega das candidaturas: emprego@ctga.pt

Caso não seja contactado(a) no prazo máximo de 15 dias após a data da formalização da sua candidatura, significa que a mesma não foi selecionada para avançar para as fases seguintes do processo de recrutamento. Agradecemos, desde já, o interesse demonstrado e o tempo dedicado à candidatura.

jobs.title: Field Marketing
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.

The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.

In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000-$160,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Finance
Customer Success Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

jobs.title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

jobs.title: Chauffører søges til faste distributionsruter hos Danmarks Fragtgruppe
jobs.description:
Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS søger flere stabile og ansvarsbevidste chauffører til vores team i Glostrup.

Vi søger chauffører til faste distributionsopgaver med udgangspunkt fra Naverland 13, 2600 Glostrup.

Stillingerne er på fuld tid og passer godt til dig, der trives med en aktiv arbejdsdag med ansvar, kundekontakt og frihed til i høj grad at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag efter aftale.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kørsel og distribution af gods på faste ruter

  • Levering af varer til erhvervskunder

  • Lastning og aflæsning

  • Indbæring af varer hos kunder

  • Sikring og korrekt håndtering af gods

  • Kontrol af varer og leverancer

  • Registrering og dokumentation af leverancer

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Ansvar for, at bilen holdes ordentlig og præsentabel

Kørslen foregår primært med 18-pallers forvogne.

Fleksibel arbejdstid

Vi ønsker at give vores chauffører mulighed for en arbejdsdag, der så vidt muligt passer til den enkelte.

Arbejdstiden kan derfor aftales individuelt inden for tidsrummet ca. kl. 06.00–18.00, afhængigt af ruterne og virksomhedens drift.

En normal arbejdsdag kan eksempelvis være 8 timer, men der kan også efter aftale være mulighed for flere timer på de dage, hvor chaufføren ønsker det, og hvor driften giver mulighed for det.

Det betyder eksempelvis, at nogle chauffører kan foretrække:

  • Tidlig opstart og tidligere fri

  • Senere opstart og senere fri

  • En almindelig arbejdsdag på omkring 8 timer

  • Længere arbejdsdage efter aftale

Den konkrete arbejdstid planlægges i samarbejde med kørselsledelsen og under hensyntagen til gældende regler om arbejdstid, pauser samt køre- og hviletid.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori C

  • Har gyldigt chaufføruddannelsesbevis/EU-kvalifikationsbevis, hvor dette er påkrævet

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Er serviceminded og ordentlig i kontakten med kunder

  • Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og indbæring

  • Behandler virksomhedens materiel og kundernes varer med respekt

  • Kan samarbejde godt med kolleger og kørselsledelsen

  • Har en professionel og positiv tilgang til arbejdet

Erfaring med distribution og lastbilkørsel er en fordel, men den rette indstilling, stabilitet og ansvarlighed vægter højt hos os.

ADR

ADR-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Har du ikke ADR-bevis, kan der efter nærmere aftale være mulighed for at tage den nødvendige ADR-uddannelse gennem virksomheden.

Løn

Vi tilbyder en timeløn på:

175–250 kr. pr. time

Den konkrete timeløn fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og afhænger blandt andet af:

  • Erfaring

  • Relevante kvalifikationer

  • Certifikater og uddannelser

  • Erfaring med distributionskørsel

  • Arbejdsopgaver og ansvar i stillingen

Vi tilbyder

  • Fastansættelse

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Faste distributionsopgaver

  • Timeløn på 175–250 kr. efter kvalifikationer

  • Mulighed for fleksibel tilrettelæggelse af arbejdstiden

  • Mulighed for både ca. 8 timers arbejdsdage og længere arbejdsdage efter aftale

  • Arbejdstid inden for ca. kl. 06.00–18.00

  • Faste rammer og tydelig kørselsplanlægning

  • Et professionelt og ordentligt arbejdsmiljø

  • Mulighed for ansvar og udvikling

  • Mulighed for ADR-uddannelse efter aftale

  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

Om Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS

Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS er en transport- og distributionsvirksomhed med fokus på driftssikker transport, god kundeservice og professionel håndtering af vores kunders varer.

Vi lægger vægt på stabile medarbejdere, godt samarbejde og en professionel tilgang til den enkelte transportopgave.

Vi ønsker samtidig at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor der så vidt muligt er plads til, at den enkelte chauffør kan få arbejdsliv og privatliv til at hænge sammen.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og gerne dit CV til:

info@dfgdk.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below, with strong experience in software development.

  • Physics

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

jobs.title: Skal du være socialfaglig medarbejder på Holbrogaard?
jobs.description:
Vi får plads til flere unge derfor søger vi socialfaglige medarbejdere med opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Holbrogaard ligger i naturskønne omgivelser tæt ved det sydfynske øhav i Faaborg. Vi tilbyder miljøterapeutisk og neoaffektiv døgnbehandling til unge i alderen 12-18 (22) år, med begyndende personlighedsforstyrrelser og psykiatrinære lidelser.

Det er en arbejdsplads for omkring 20 medarbejdere med såvel sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske uddannelser, hvor det faglige niveau er højt. Behandlingen af hver enkelt ung, er nøje tilrettelagt efter den unges individuelle behov og foregår i et omsorgsfuldt bo-miljø.

Skoletilbuddet aftales med den anbringende kommune for hver enkelt ung og foregår i nærmiljøet. Det er med til at skabe den bedste udvikling i den unges liv.

Behandlingen tager udgangspunkt i evidensbaseret miljøterapi og neuroaffektive og systemiske principper. Det betyder, at vores behandlingsmetoder er veldokumenterede og tager hensyn til og inddrager alle aspekter af den unges liv.
For at udvikle fagligheden, er der løbende efteruddannelse og supervision.

Med andre ord: Holbrogaard lykkes, når unge udvikles og styrkes mod et bæredygtigt liv.

Med udgangspunkt i en stærk faglighed og blikket hævet mod ovenstående kerneopgave, arbejder vi bevidst insisterende mod at lykkes sammen med de unge.

Dette stiller store krav til os som behandlingssted og vores pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige handlinger.

Kan du se dig selv ind i ovenstående og har du følgende kvalifikationer hører vi meget gerne fra dig.
  • Har en social eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse – som pædagog, psykolog, socialrådgiver, ergoterapeut eller social og sundhedsassistent alternativt en anden relevant uddannelse på min. bachelorer niveau.
  • Har erfaring med faglig dokumentation.
  • Psykisk robust og rummelig.
  • Ser arbejdet omkring den unge som en helhedsorienteret opgave der indeholder tæt samarbejde med forældre og anbringende kommuner.
  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, evaluere og prioritere opgaver i samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og samtidig fokusere på den enkelte unges behov.
  • Gerne kompetencer til at arbejde motorisk, musisk og kreativt med de unge.
  • Gerne kendskab til psykiatrien.
  • Lyst til at dele og udvikle viden i tæt samspil med kollegaerne.
  • Anerkendende tilgang til kollegaer, de unge og deres familier.
  • At du trives i et tværfagligt samarbejdsmiljø.
  • At du trives med at løse kerneopgaven.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har erfaring fra psykiatri og døgninstitutioner med lignende målgruppe.

Vi tilbyder:
  • God introduktion.
  • Forplejning når du er på arbejde, attraktiv sundhedsordning.
  • Supervision og efteruddannelse.
  • En engageret og ambitiøs tværfaglig personalegruppe, bestående af både medarbejdere med mange års erfaring på stedet, og nogle medarbejdere ansat inden for det sidste år.
  • Vi lægger vægt på et sundt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, og høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen – og ser disse to som hinandens forudsætning.

For alle medarbejdere er der obligatorisk deltagelse i behandlingskonference, personalemøder og supervision.

Vi aflønner efter gældende overenskomst med SL/FOA.

Ren straffeattest, børneattest og gyldigt førerbevis er en forudsætning for ansættelse.

Stillingerne er alle på 32 timer pr. uge og arbejdstiderne er dag, aften og fast hver 2. weekend

Ansøgningsfristen er nu!

Sagt med andre ord vi tager løbende kandidater ind til samtale og opslaget vil blive taget ned, når vi er nået i mål med de rette kandidater.

Evt. spørgsmål til stillingerne?
Så er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Holbrogaard, Jens Simmelsgaard på mobil 2260 0561 eller souschef, Kristoffer Aarup på mobil 2519 4466.

Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

 CPH Skadecenter er startet af en pladesmed og idag drevet af en pladesmed, dvs. at der er fuld forståelse for de udfordringer der kan opstå i forbindelse med at udbedre skader på alle bilmærker. Mvh. Mads Milan Petersen / CPH Skadecenter ApS

jobs.title: KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling
jobs.description:
KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling

Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt elektronikteam og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, effektiv drift og motiverede medarbejdere? Så er du måske vores nye arbejdsleder til Elektronikafdelingen. Vi arbejder hovedsageligt på nybygninger og er med fra de første spæde installationer til de sidste, færdige installation ombord på topmoderne fartøjer.

Som arbejdsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af elektronikafdelingen i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen. Du bliver en central del af produktionen, hvor du sikrer effektiv planlægning, høj kvalitet i arbejdet og synlig ledelse af afdelingens medarbejdere.

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for både medarbejdere, produktion, kvalitet og opfølgning på opgaver og ressourcer.

 

Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • Erfaring fra den maritime branche er en fordel.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores produktionschef, René Hansen, på tlf. (+45) 26 87 44 33.

 

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. Dertil har vi en ordrebog på 5-7 nybygninger og mellem 100-150 reparations – og større ombygningsopgaver om året.
